a: Hay "aviha hi mechallelet", may daresh beh?

Mibbee leh lechidtanya: haya rabbi meir omer, ma talmud lomar "et aviha hi mechallelet"? sheim hayu nohagin bo kodesh – nohagin bo chol, kavod – nohagin bo bizzayon. omrin: "arur shezzo yalad, arur shezzo giddel, arur sheyyatza zo mechalatzav".
Amar rav ashe: keman karenan "rashshia bar rashshia", vaafillu lerashshia bar tzaddika, keman? kehay tanna.
Zo mitzvat hanniskalin. may tanna dekatane zo mitzvat hanniskalin?
Mishshum ditna: nigmar haddin motziin oto lesoklo. bet hassekila haya gavoah shete komot. veayyeyde deka vae lemitne mitzvat hannisrafin, tena name zo mitzvat hanniskalin.

Mishna mitzvat hannisrafin – hayu meshakkein oto bazzevel ad archubbotav, venotnin sudar kasha letoch harakka, vechorech al tzavvaro. ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo, ad sheppoteach et piv. umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv, veyoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav.

Rabbi yehuda omer: af hu, im met beyadam – lo hayu mekayyeymin bo mitzvat serefa, ella poteach et piv bitzvat shello betovato, umadlik et happetila vezorkah letoch piv, veyoredet letoch meav vechomeret et bene meav.
Amar rabbi elazar ben tzadok: maase bevat kohen achat shezzinneta, vehikkifuha chavile zemorot userafuha. amru lo: mippene shello haya bet din shel otah shaa baki.
Gemara may petila? amar rav matna: petila shel avar.
Mena lan? atya "serefa" "serefa" meadat korach. ma lehallan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym, af kan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym.
Rabbi elazar amar: atya serefa serefa mibbene aharon, ma lehallan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym – af kan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym.
Man deyalef meadat korach, mena leh? dichtiv: "veet machtot hachattaim haelle benafshotam", shennishmatan nisrefet veguf kayyaym.
Veiddach: hahi serefa mammash hi. umay "benafshotam"? shennitchayyeyvu serefa al iske nafshotam.
Kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "bechanfe laage maog charok alay shinnemo"? bishvil chanuppa shehechnifu lekorach al iske legima, charak alehen sar shel gehinnam shinnav.
Uman deyalef mibbene aharon mena leh? dichtiv: "vayyamutu lifne Adonai", keen mita.

Veiddach: hahu serefa mammash havay. umay dichtiv "vayyamutu"? deatchel behu miggavvay, keen mita. detanya, abba yose ben dostay omer: shene chutin shel esh yatzu mibbet kodesh hakkodashim venechleku learba, venichnesu shenayim bechotmo shel ze ushenayim bechotmo shel ze userafum.
Vehachtiv: "vattochal otam"! otam, velo bigdehem.
Venelaf mipparim hannisrafim, ma lehallan serefa mammash – af kan serefa mammash?
Mistabbera meadam hava leh lemelaf, shekken adam, chote, neshama, piggul.
Adderabba, mipparim hannisrafim hava leh lemelaf, shekken machshir ledorot.
Hanach nefishin.
Man deyalef meadat korach, may tama la yalef mibbene aharon? hahu serefa mammash havay. venelaf minna?
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: amar kera "veahavta lereacha kamocha", beror lo mita yafa.
Vechi meachar deikka derav nachman, gezera shava lema li?
I lav gezera shava, hava amena: serefat neshama veguf kayyaym – lav serefa hi kelal. vei mishshum "veahavta lereacha kamocha", lappesh leh chavile zemorot ki hechi delisrof laagal. ka mashma lan.

Uchevar hayu moshe veaharon mehallechin badderech, venadav vaavihu mehallechin acharehen, vechol yisrael acharehen. amar lo nadav laavihu: ematay yamutu shene zekenim hallalu vaani veatta nanhig et haddor? amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: hanire mi kover et mi. amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: nefishe gamle save ditini mashche dehugene.
Amar rabbi eliezer:
b: Lema talmid chacham dome lifne am haaretz? battechilla, dome lekiton shel zahav. sipper hemennu, dome lekiton shel kesef. nehena mimmennu, dome lekiton shel cheres. kevan shennishbar, shuv en lo takkana.
Immarta bat tale, bat kohen shezzinneta havay. akkefa (rav) chama bar toviyya chavile zemorot vesarfa.

Amar rav yosef: tea betarte, tea bidrav matna, utea bidtanya. "uvata el hakkohanim haleviyyim veel hashshofet asher yihye bayyamim hahem" – bizman sheyyesh kohen yesh mishpat, bizman sheen kohen en mishpat.
Amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: maase bevat kohen shezzinneta vechulei. amar rav yosef: bet din shel tzaddukim hava.

Hachi amar lehu, vehachi ahdaru leh? vehatanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: zechurani keshehayiti tinok umurekav al ketefo shel abba, veheviu bat kohen shezzinneta vehikkifuha chavile zemorot userafuha. amru lo: katan hayita, veen meviin reaya min hakkatan. shene maasim havo.
He amar lehu beresha? ilema ha kammayyta amar lehu beresha, amar leh keshehu gadol, vela ashgachu beh. amar lehu keshehu katan, veashgachu beh?
Ella, ha amar lehu beresha, vaamaru leh: katan hayita, vaamar lehu keshehu gadol, vaamaru leh: mippene shello haya bet din shel otah shaa baki.

Mishna mitzvat hanneheragin hayu mattizin et rosho besayif, kederech shehammalchut osa. rabbi yehuda omer: niuul hu lo, ella mannichin et rosho al hassaddan vekotzetz bekofitz. amru lo: en mita menvveulet mizzo.
Gemara tanya, amar lahen rabbi yehuda lachachamim: af ani yodea shemmita menuvvelet hi, aval ma eese? shehare amra tora "uvechukkotehem lo telechu".
Verabbanan, kevan dichtiv sayif beorayyta, la minnayyhu ka gamrinan.

Dei la tema hachi, ha detanya: sorfin al hammelachim, velo middarche haemori – hechi sarfinan? vehachtiv: "uvechukkotehem lo telechu"! ella, kevan dichtiv serefa beorayyta, dichtiv: "uvemisrefot avotecha vegomer", lav minnayyhu ka gamrinan. vehacha name, kevan dichtiv sayif beorayyta, lav minnayyhu ka gamrinan.
Veha ditnan beiddach pirkin: ellu hen hanneheragin: harotzeach, veanshe ir hanniddachat. bishlama ir hanniddachat – ketiv behu "lefi charev", ella rotzeach – menalan?
Detanya: "nakom yinnakem" – nekima zo eni yodea ma hi. keshehu omer: "veheveti alechem cherev nokemet nekam berit", heve omer: nekima zo sayif.
Veema: devarez leh mivraz? "lefi charev" ketiv!
Veema deaved leh gistera? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: amar kera "veahavta lereacha kamocha", beror lo mita yafa.
Ashkechan diktal avda, bar chorin mena lan?
Velav kal vachomer hu: ketal avda besayif, bar chorin bechenek?
Hanicha leman deamar: chenek kal, ella leman deamar: chenek chamur, may ikka lememar?
Nafka leh middetanya: "veatta tevaer haddam hannaki mikkirbecha" – hukeshu kol shofche damim leegla arufa. ma lehallan besayif umin hatztzavvar, af kan besayif umin hatztzavvar.
I, ma lehallan bekofitz umimmul oref, af kan bekofitz umimmul oref? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: amar kera "veahavta lereacha kamocha" – beror lo mita yafa.
Mishna mitzvat hannechnakin: hayu meshakkein oto bezevel ad archubbotav, venoten sudar kasha letoch harakka, vechorech al tzavvaro. ze moshech etzlo veze moshech etzlo, ad shennafsho yotzet.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "ish" – perat lekatan, "asher yinaf et eshet ish" – perat leeshet katan, "eshet reehu" – perat leeshet acherim.

"Mot yumat" – bechenek. atta omer bechenek, o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora? amarta: kol makom shenneemar mita betora setam, en atta rashshay lemoshchah lehachemir aleha, ella lehakel aleha. divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: lo mippene shehi kalla, ella kol mita haamura betora setam – enah ella chenek.
Rabbi omer: neemar mita bide shamayim, veneemar mita bide adam. ma mita haamura bide shamayim – mita sheen bah roshem, af mita haamura bide adam – mita sheen bah roshem.
Veema serefa? middeamar rachamana bat kohen bisrefa, mikkelal deha lav bat serefa hi.

a: Bishlama lerabbi yonatan, kidka mefaresh rabbi tama. ella lerabbi yoshiyya, mimmay deikka chenek baolam? ema sayif!
Amar rava: arba mitot gemara gemiri lehu.
May "lo mippene shehi kalla"? kamippalgi biflugeta derabbi shimon verabbanan.
Amar leh rabbi zera leabbaye: shear hanniskalin dela ketiv behu sekila, degamri meov veyiddeoni, bemay gamri? bemot yumatu" gamri, o bidmehem bam" gamri?
Amar leh: bidmehem" "demehem bam" gamri, dei bemot yumatu" gamri, "demehem" "demehem" lema li?
Ella may, bidmehem" "demehem" gamri? "mot yumatu" lema li?

Kidtanya: "mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu" – en li ella bemita hakketuva bo. minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo, sheatta memito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito? talmud lomar: "mot yumat hammakke" – mikkol makom.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: vei bemot yumatu" gamri, may ka kashya leh?
Illema eshet ish ka kashya leh, lemete ulemigmar "mot yumat" meov veyiddeoni: ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila?
Middeamar rachamana arusa biskila, mikkelal dinsua lav biskila.
Veella, makke aviv veimmo ka kashya leh, lemete ulemigmar meov veyiddeoni?
Ad degamri meov veyiddeoni, ligmeru meeshet ish, dei atta rashshay lemoshchah lehachemir aleha, ella lehakel aleha.
Amar leh: shear hanniskalin gufayyhu ka kashya leh, dei bemot yumat" gamri, ad degamri meov veyiddeoni, ligmeru meeshet ish!

Mishna ellu hen hanniskalin: habba al haem, veal eshet haav, veal hakkalla, veal hazzechur, veal habbehema, vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema. vehamegaddef, vehaoved avoda zara, vehannoten mizzaro lammolech, uvaal ov veyiddeoni, vehamechallel et hashshabbat, vehamekallel aviv veimmo, vehabba al naara hameorasa, vehammesit, vehammediach, vehamechashshef, uven sorer umore.
Habba al haem, chayyayv aleha mishshum em umishshum eshet av. rabbi yehuda omer: eno chayyayv ella mishshum haem bilvad.
Habba al eshet av, chayyayv mishshum eshet av umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin.
Habba al kallato, chayyayv aleha mishshum kallato umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye veno ben leachar mitat beno, ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin.
Gemara tanya: rabbi yehuda omer, im lo hayta immo reuya leaviv, eno chayyayv ella mishshum haem bilvad.
May "enah reuya lo"? illema chayyayve charetot vechayyayve mitot bet din, mikkelal derabbanan savri af al gav deenah reuya lo? ha let leh kiddushin begavvav!
Ella: chayyayve lavin, verabbi yehuda savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: en kiddushin tofsin bechayyayve lavin.
Metiv rav oshaya: issur mitzva veissur kedushsha – choltzot velo mityaybmot.
b: Issur mitzva – sheniyyot middivre sofrim. veammay karu lehu issur mitzva? shemmitzva lishmoa divre chachamim.
Issur kedushsha – almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. veammay karu lehu issur kedushsha? dichtiv: "kedoshim yihyu lelohehem".
Vetanya ala: rabbi yehuda machlif.

Challofe hu demachlef, ha chalitza baaya. vei salka datach rabbi yehuda kerabbi akiva sevira leh, mikkedi chayyayve lavin lerabbi akiva kechayyayve charetot deme, vechayyayve charetot lav bene chalitza veyibbum ninhu!
Lidvarav detanna kamma kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Ki ata rabbi yitzchak, tane keditnan: rabbi yehuda omer, eno chayyayv ella mishshum haem bilvad.
Vetama may? amar abbaye: deamar kera "immecha hi". mishshum immo atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum eshet av.
Ella meatta, "ervat eshet avicha lo tegalle ervat avicha hi", mishshum eshet av atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum immo?

Ella immo shehi eshet aviv, kae hacha umemaet la, kae hacha umemaet la. hasheta, immo sheenah eshet aviv – michayyayv, eshet aviv sheenah immo – michayyayv, immo shehi eshet aviv – la michayyayv kelal?
Vetu, lerabbanan name, hachtiv "immecha hi"? ella, hahu mibbee leh lechidrav shisha bereh derav idi. lerabbi yehuda name, hahu mibbee leh lechidrav shisha bereh derav idi.
Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika: amar kera "ervatah", mishshum erva achat atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete arayot.
Ella meatta: "ervat kallatcha lo tegalle eshet bincha hi lo tegalle ervatah" – hachi name mishshum erva achat atta mechayyeyvo vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum shete arayot?
Vehatnan: habba al kallato chayyayv aleha mishshum kallato umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye veno ben leachar mitat beno, vela pelig rabbi yehuda.
Ella, kevan dechad gufa hu, af al gav ditre issure ninhu, ketiv "ervatah". hacha name, kevan dechad gufa hu, af al gav ditre issure ninhu, ketiv "ervatah".
Ella amar rava: kasavar rabbi yehuda "ervat avicha" – zo eshet avicha, umayyte la bigzera shava.

Umashma, ben eshet aviv shehi immo ben eshet aviv sheenah immo. immo sheenah eshet aviv minnayin? talmud lomar: "ervat immecha lo tegalle immecha hi". mishshum immo atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum eshet aviv.

a: Tanya kevavteh derava: "ish" – perat lekatan.

"Asher yishkav et eshet aviv" – mashma ben eshet aviv shehi immo, uven eshet aviv shello immo. immo sheenah eshet aviv minnayin? talmud lomar: "ervat aviv gilla", mufene lehakkish veladun mimmennu gezera shava.
"Mot yumetu" – biskila. atta omer biskila, o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora? neemar kan "demehem bam", veneemar beov veyiddeoni "demehem bam". ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila.
Onesh shamanu, azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "ervat avicha lo tegalle". "ervat avicha" – zo eshet avicha.

Atta omer: "eshet avicha", o eno ella ervat avicha mammash? neemar kan "ervat avicha lo tegalle", veneemar lehallan "ervat aviv gilla". ma lehallan beishut hakkatuv medabber, af kan beishut hakkatuv medabber.
Umashma, ben eshet aviv shehi immo, ben eshet aviv sheenah immo. immo sheenah eshet aviv minnayin? talmud lomar: "ervat immecha lo tegalle".
En li ella beazhara, sheasa hakkatuv immo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv. onesh minnayin?

Neemar kan "ervat avicha lo tegalle", veneemar lehallan "ervat aviv gilla". ma beazhara asa hakkatuv immo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv, af beonesh asa hakkatuv immo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv.
"Immecha hi" – mishshum immo atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum eshet av.
Verabbanan, "ervat avicha" – mammash.
Hay mivveet zachar" nafka? lechayyev alav shetayim.
Vechidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: nochri habba al aviv – chayyayv shetayim, habba al achi aviv – chayyayv shetayim.

Amar rava: mistabbera milleta derav yehuda beyisrael beshogeg, uvekorban. vehay dekaamar nochri – lishshana mealleya hu. dei salka datach nochri mammash, dino may nihu? ketala! bitre ketale katlat leh?
Tanya name hachi: habba al aviv – chayyayv shetayim, habba al achi aviv – chayyayv shetayim.
Ikka deamri: dela kerabbi yehuda.
Veikka deamri: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, umayyte la bekal vachomer meachi aviv. uma achi aviv, dekureva deaviv hu, chayyayv shetayim – aviv lo kol shekken?
Vekamippalgi biflugeta deabbaye verava. mar savar: onshin min haddin, umar savar: en onshin min haddin.
Verabbanan, azhara leeshet aviv mena lehu? nafka lehu meervat eshet avicha lo tegalle".
Verabbi yehuda, hahu mibbee leh leazhara leeshet aviv leachar mita.
Verabbanan, hahu missefa dikra nafka: "ervat avicha hi".
Verabbi yehuda, hahu mibbee leh: mishshum eshet av atta mechayyeyvo, vei atta mechayyeyvo mishshum eshet ish.
Vehaanan tenan: habba al eshet av, chayyayv aleha mishshum eshet av umishshum eshet ish, ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv, vela pelig rabbi yehuda?
Amar abbaye: pelig bevarayyta.
Verabbanan, onesh deeshet aviv leachar mita mena lehu? bishlama rabbi yehuda mayyte la bigzera shava, ella rabbanan mena lehu?
Amri lach: hahu "ervat aviv gilla" demappek la rabbi yehuda ligzera shava, mappeki leh inhu leonesh deeshet aviv leachar mita.
Verabbanan, onesh leimmo sheenah eshet aviv mena lehu? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: amar kera "immecha hi". asaah hakkatuv leimmo sheenah eshet aviv keimmo shehi eshet aviv.
Habba al kallato kulei. velichayyayv name mishshum eshet beno? amar abbaye: patach hakkatuv bechallato vesiyyem beeshet beno, lomar lach zo hi kallato zo hi eshet beno.

Mishna habba al hazzechur, veal habbehema, vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema – biskila. im adam chata, behema me chata? ella lefi shebbaa leadam takkala al yadah, lefichach amar hakkatuv tissakel. davar acher: shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru "zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah".
Gemara zachar mena lan? detanu rabbanan: "ish" – perat lekatan, "asher yishkav et zachar" – ben gadol ben katan, "mishkeve ishsha" – maggid lecha hakkatuv sheshshene mishkavot baishsha.
Amar rabbi yishmael: hare ze ba lelammed, venimtza lamed.
"Mot yumatu" – biskila. atta omer biskila, o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora? neemar kan "demehem bam", veneemar beov veyiddeoni "demehem bam". ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila.
b: Onesh shamanu, azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha toeva hi".

Lamadnu azhara lashshochev. azhara lannishkav minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael". veomer: "vegam kadesh haya vaaretz asu kechol hattoavot haggoyim asher horish vegomer". divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "veet zachar lo tishkav mishkeve ishsha". keri beh "lo tishshachev".
Behema mena lan? detanu rabbanan: "ish" – perat lekatan, "asher yitten shechovto bivhema" – ben gedola ben ketanna.
"Mot yumat" – biskila. atta omer biskila, o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora? neemar kan "taharogu", veneemar lehallan "ki harog tahargennu". ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila.
Lamadnu onesh lashshochev. onesh lannishkav menalan? talmud lomar: "kol shochev im behema mot yumat". im eno inyan lashshochev, tenehu inyan lannishkav.
Lamadnu onesh ben lashshochev ben lannishkav. azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "uvechol behema lo titten shechovtecha letoma vah".
Lamadnu azhara lashshochev. lannishkav minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo yihye kadesh mibbene yisrael", veomer: "vegam kadesh haya baaretz vegomer". divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "lo titten shechovtecha" – lo titten shechivatcha.
Habba al hazzechur, vehevi alav zachar.
Amar rabbi avahu: ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyayv shetayim, chada millo tishkav" vachada millo yihye kadesh". ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyayv ella achat. "lo tishkav" "lo tishshachev" chada hi.

Habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav, amar rabbi avahu: ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyayv shetayim, chada millo titten shechovtecha" vachada millo yihye kadesh". ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyayv ella achat, "shechovtecha" ushechivatcha" chada hi.
Abbaye amar: afillu ledivre rabbi yishmael name eno chayyayv ella achat, dechi chetiv "lo yihye kadesh" – begavre ketiv.
Ella lerabbi yishmael, azhara lannishkav mena leh? nafka leh mikkol shochev im behema mot yumat". im eno inyan lashshochev, tenehu inyan lannishkav.
Veappekeh rachamana lannishkav bilshon shochev: ma shochev anash vehizhir, af nishkav anash vehizhir.

Hannirba lezachar vehannirba livhema, amar rabbi avahu: ledivre rabbi akiva chayyayv shetayim, chada millo tishkav" vachada millo titten shechovtecha". ledivre rabbi yishmael eno chayyayv ella achat, idde veidi "lo yihye kadesh" hu.

Abbaye amar: afillu ledivre rabbi yishmael name chayyayv shetayim, dichtiv "kol shochev im behema mot yumat". im eno inyan lashshochev, tenehu inyan lannishkav. veappekeh rachamana lannishkav bilshon shochev: ma shochev – anash vehizhir, af nishkav – anash vehizhir.
Aval habba al hazzechur, vehevi zachar alav, habba al habbehema, vehevi behema alav – ben lerabbi avahu ben leabbaye, lerabbi yishmael chayyayv shalosh, lerabbi akiva chayyayv shetayim.
Tanu rabbanan: zechur – lo asu bo katan kegadol, behema – asu bah ketanna kigdola.
May "lo asu bo katan kegadol"? amar rav: lo asu biat pachot mibben tesha shanim keven tesha shanim. ushemuel amar: lo asu biat pachot mibben shalosh shanim keven shalosh shanim.
Bemay kamippalgi? rav savar: kol deiteh beshochev – iteh benishkav, vechol deleteh beshochev – leteh benishkav.
Ushemuel savar: "mishkeve ishsha" ketiv.
Tanya kevavteh derav: zachar ben tesha shanim veyom echad

a: Habba al habbehema, ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah, vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema aleha, ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah – chayyayv.
Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda: beishsha shene mishkavot, uvivhema mishkav echad.
Matkef la rav pappa: adderabba, ishsha deorcha hi ammishkav michayyayv, ammiddaam acharina la michayyayv. behema delav orcha hi, lichayyayv ala al kol nekev vanekev.

Tanya (dela ketarvayyhu): zachar ben tesha shanim veyom echad habba al habbehema, ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah, vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema aleha, ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah – chayyayv.
Amar leh ravina lerava: hameare bizchur, mahu?
Hameare bizchur – mishkeve ishsha ketiv beh. ella, hameare bivhema, mahu?
Amar leh: im eno inyan lehaaraa dichtiva gabbe achot aviv vaachot immo, dela tzericha, deha ittakkash lehaaraa denidda – tenehu inyan lehaaraa divhema.

Mikkede, behema mechayyayve mitot bet din hi, lema li dichtiv lehaaraa dida gabbe chayyayve charetot? lichteveh gabbe chayyayve mitot bet din, veligmor chayyayve mitot bet din mechayyayve mitot bet din!
Hoil vechulleh kera lidrasha hu deate, ketiva name milleta didrasha.
Bea minneh rav achadvuy bar amme merav sheshet: hameare beatzmo, mahu? amar leh: kevastan!

Amar rav ashe: may tibbee lach? bekoshi la mashkachat la, ki mashkachat la bimshammesh met. leman deamar meshammesh met baarayot patur, hacha patur. uleman deamar chayyayv, hacha michayyayv tarte: michayyayv ashshochev, umichayyayv annishkav.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: goy habba al habbehema mahu? takkala vekalon baenan, vehacha takkala ikka, kalon lekka? o dilma takkala, af al pi sheen kalon?

Amar rav sheshet: tenetuha, ma ilanot sheen ochlin veen shotin veen merichin, amra tora: hashechet, serof vechalle, hoil uvat leadam takkala al yadan. hammate et chavero middarche chayyim ledarche mita – al achat kamma vechamma.
Ella meatta, goy hammishtachave livhemto tittesar umikkatla? mi ikka midde dilyisrael la asar ulegoy asar?
Yisrael gufeh littesar, midde dehave arvia? amar abbaye: ze kelono merubbe, veze kelono muat.
Vahare ilanot, deen kelonan merubbe, veamra tora: hashechet, serof vechalle! bevaale chayyim kaamrinan, dechas rachamana alayyhu.
Rava amar: amra tora, behema nehenet meavera – tehareg.
Vahare ilanot, deen nehenin meavera, veamra tora: hashechet, serof vechalle! bevaale chayyim kaamrinan, dechas rachamana alayyhu.
Ta shema: davar acher, shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru: "zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah." may lav,
b: Middesefa takkala vekalon, resha takkala belo kalon. vehechi dame? goy habba al habbehema.
La, sefa takkala vekalon. resha ha ka mashma lan: daafillu kalon belo takkala name michayyeyvi. vehechi dame? yisrael habba al habbehema beshogeg, vechidvae rav hamenuna.
Devae rav hamenuna: yisrael habba al habbehema beshogeg, mahu? takkala vekalon baenan, vehacha kalon ikka, takkala lekka? o dilma kalon, af al pi sheen takkala?
Amar rav yosef: ta shema, bat shalosh shanim veyom echad mitkaddeshet bevia, veim ba aleha yavam kenaah, vechayyayvin aleha mishshum eshet ish.
Umetammea et boalah, letamme mishkav tachton keelyon. nisset lechohen – ochelet bitruma. ba aleha echad min happesulim – pesalah min hakkehunna.
Veim ba aleha echad mikkol haarayot haamurot betora, mumatin al yadah, vehi petura.
Echad mikkol arayot, vaafillu behema. veha hacha dekalon ikka, takkala lekka, vekatane: mumatin al yadah.
Kevan dimzida hi, takkala name ikka, verachamana hu dechas ala. ala dida chas, abbehema la chas.
Amar rava: ta shema, ben tesha shanim veyom echad habba al yevimto – kenaah, veeno noten get ad sheyyagdil. umetamme kenidda letamme mishkav tachton keelyon.
Posel veeno maachil, ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach, veniskelet al yado. veim ba al achat mikkol haarayot haamurot betora, mumatim al yado.
Veha hacha kalon ikka, takkala lekka, vekatane: niskelet al yado.
Kevan demezid hu, takkala name ikka, verachamana hu dechas illaveh. aleh dideh chas rachamana, abbehema la chas rachamana.

Ta shema: davar acher, shello tehe behema overet bashshuk veyomru: "zo hi shenniskal peloni al yadah". may lav, middesefa takkala vekalon, resha kalon belo takkala? vehechi dame? yisrael habba al habbehema beshogeg.
La, sefa takkala vekalon, resha takkala belo kalon. vehechi dame? goy habba al habbehema, uchedivo minneh merav sheshet.
Mishna hamegaddef eno chayyayv ad sheyyefaresh hashshem. amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha:

a: Bechol yom danin et haedim bechinnuy, "yakke yosi et yosi".

Nigmar haddin, lo [hayu] horgin bechinnuy, ella motziin kol adam lachutz. shoalin et haggadol shebbenehen veomer lo: "emor ma sheshshamata beferush". vehu omer, vehaddayyaynin omdin al raglehen vekorin, velo meachin.
Vehashsheni omer: "af ani kamohu", vehashshelishi omer: "af ani kamohu".
Gemara tana: ad sheyyevarech shem beshem.
Menahane mille? amar shemuel: deamar kera "venokev shem vegomer benokvo shem yumat".
Mimmay dehay "nokev" lishshana devaroche hu? dichtiv: "ma ekkov lo kabbo el". veazharteh mehacha: "elohim lo tekallel".
Veema: mivraz hu, dichtiv "vayyikkov chor bedalto", veazharteh mehacha: "veibbadtem et shemam... lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem"?
Baena shem beshem, velekka.
Veema demannach shene shemot ahadade, uvaza lehu? hahu nokev vechozer venokev hu. veema dechayek shem appumma desakkina, uvaza ba? hahu churepa desakkina hu deka vaza.
Ema: paroshe shemeh hu, dichtiv: "vayyikkach moshe veaharon et haanashim haelle asher nikkevu beshemot". veazharteh mehacha: "et Adonai elohecha tira".
Chada, devaena shem beshem velekka. veod, havya leh azharat ase, veazharat ase la shema azhara.
Veibbaet ema: amar kera "vayyikkov... vaykallel", lememra denokev kelala hu.
Vedilma ad deaved tarvayyhu? la salka datach, dichtiv: "hotze et hamekallel", vela ketiv: "hotze et hannokev vehamekallel". shema minna chada hi.
Tanu rabbanan: "ish" – ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot et haggoyim, shemmuzeharin al birkat hashshem keyisrael. veenan neheragin ella besayif, shekkol mita haamura bivne noach enah ella besayif.
Veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka: "Adonai" – zo birkat hashshem.
Amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: lo nitzrecha ella lerabbot et hakkinnuyin, veallibba derabbi meir.

Detanya: "ish ish ki yekallel elohav venasa cheto" – ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar: "venokev shem Adonai mot yumat"! lefi shenneemar "venokev shem mot yumat", yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella al shem hameyuchad bilvad? minnayin lerabbot kol hakkinnuyin? talmud lomar: "ish ki yekallel elohav" – mikkol makom. divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: al shem hameyuchad bemita, veal hakkinnuyin beazhara.
Ufeliga derabbi meyaysha, deamar rabbi meyaysha: ben noach shebberach et hashshem bechinnuy, lerabbanan chayyayv.
May tama? deamar kera: "kagger kaezrach". ger veezrach hu devaenan "benokvo shem", aval goy – afillu bechinnuy.
Verabbi meir, hay "kagger kaezrach" may aved leh? ger veezrach biskila, aval goy besayif. salka datach amena: hoil veitrabbo, itrabbo – ka mashma lan.
Verabbi yitzchak nappacha, allibba derabbanan, hay "kagger kaezrach" may aved leh? ger veezrach hu devaenan shem beshem, aval goy la baenan shem beshem.
"Ish ish" – lema li? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.
Tanu rabbanan: sheva mitzvot nitztauu bene noach – dinin, uvirkat hashshem, avoda zara, gilluy arayot, ushefichut damim, vegazel, veever min hachay.
b: Rabbi chananya ben gamla omer: af al haddam min hachay. rabbi chidka omer: af al hasserus. rabbi shimon omer: af al hakkishshuf.

Rabbi yose omer: kol haamur befarashat kishshuf – ben noach muzehar alav. "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh kosem kesamim meonen umenachesh umechashshef. vechover chaver veshoel ov veyiddeoni vedoresh el hammetim vegomer. uviglal hattoevot haelle Adonai elohecha morish otam mippanecha". velo anash ella im ken hizhir.
Rabbi elazar omer: af al hakkilayim. muttarin bene noach lilbosh kilayim velizroa kilayim, veen asurin ella beharebaat behema uveharkavat hailan.
Menahane mille? amar rabbi yochanan: deamar kera, "vaytzav Adonai elohim al haadam lemor mikkol etz haggan achol tochel".
"Vaytzav" – ellu haddinin, vechen hu omer: "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve et banav vegomer".

"Adonai" – zo birkat hashshem, vechen hu omer: "venokev shem Adonai mot yumat". "elohim" – zo avoda zara, vechen hu omer: "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim". "al haadam" – zo shefichut damim, vechen hu omer: "shofech dam haadam vegomer".
"Lemor" – zo gilluy arayot, vechen hu omer: "lemor hen yeshallach ish et ishto vehalcha meitto vehayta leish acher". "mikkol etz haggan" – velo gazel. "achol tochel" – velo ever min hachay.
Ki ata rabbi yitzchak, tane ippecha: "vaytzav" – zo avoda zara, "elohim" – zo dinin.
Bishlama "elohim" – zo dinin, dichtiv: "venikrav baal habbayit el haelohim". ella "vaytzav" – zo avoda zara, may mashma?
Rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avdimi: chad amar, "saru maher min hadderech asher tzivvitim asu lahem vegomer", vechad amar, "ashuk efrayim retzutz mishpat ki hoil halach achare tzav".
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu: goy sheasa avoda zara velo hishtachava lah. leman deamar "asu" – mishsheat asiyyay mechayyev. leman deamar "ki hoil halach" – ad deazel batra ufalach la.

Amar rava: umi ikka leman deamar goy sheasa avoda zara velo hishtachava lah – chayyayv? vehatanya: baavoda zara, devarim shebbet din shel yisrael memitin alehen – ben noach muzehar alehen; en bet din shel yisrael memitin alehen – en ben noach muzehar alehen. lemaote may? lav lemaote goy sheasa avoda zara velo hishtachava lah?
Amar rav pappa: la, lemaote gippuf venishshuk.
Gippuf venishshuk demay? illema kedarkah – bar ketala hu! ella, lemaote shello kedarkah.
Dinin bene noach ippekud? vehatanya: eser mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bemara, sheva shekkibbelu alehen bene noach, vehosifu alehen dinin veshabbat vechibbud av vaem.
Dinin, dichtiv: "sham sam lo chok umishpat". shabbat vechibbud av vaem, dichtiv: "kaasher tzivvecha Adonai elohecha". veamar rav yehuda: "kaasher tzivvecha" – bemara.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo nitzrecha ella laeda, veedim, vehateraa.
I hachi, may "vehosifu alehen dinin"?
Ella amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella ledine kenasot. akkatti, "vehosifu bedinin" mibbee leh!

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov: lo nitzrecha ella lehoshiv bet din bechol pelech vafelech, uvechol ir vair. veha bene noach la ippekud? vehatanya: keshem shennitztauu yisrael lehoshiv batte dinin bechol pelech vafelech uvechol ir vair, kach nitztauu bene noach lehoshiv batte dinin bechol pelech vafelech uvechol ir vair.
Ella amar rava: hay tanna tanna deve menashshe hu, demappek dach veayel sach.
Detanna deve menashshe: sheva mitzvot nitztauu bene noach – avoda zara, vegilluy arayot, ushefichut damim, gazel, veever min hachay, serus, vechilayim.

Rabbi yehuda omer: adam harishon lo nitztavvav ella al avoda zara bilvad, shenneemar "vaytzav Adonai elohim al haadam". rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: af al birkat hashshem. veyesh omrim: af al haddinim.
Keman azla ha deamar rav yehuda amar rav: "elohim ani" – lo tekalleluni, "elohim ani" – lo temiruni, "elohim ani" – yehe morai alechem? keman? keyesh omrim.
Vetanna deve menashshe: i daresh "vaytzav" – afillu hanach name, i la daresh "vaytzav" – hane mena leh?
Leolam la daresh "vaytzav". hane, kol chada vachada beappe nafsha ketiva: avoda zara vegilluy arayot -

a: Dichtiv: "vattishshachet haaretz lifne haelohim". vetana deve rabbi yishmael: bechol makom shenneemar hashechata, eno ella devar erva vaavoda zara. davar erva – shenneemar: "ki hishchit kol basar et darko". avoda zara – dichtiv: "pen tashchitun vaasitem vegomer".
Veiddach, orchayyhu deka megalle.
Shefichut damim, dichtiv: "shofech dam haadam vegomer". veiddach? ketalayyhu hu dekamgalle.
Gazel, dichtiv: "keyerek esev natatti lachem et kol". veamar rabbi levi: keyerek esev, velo keyerek ginna. veiddach? hahu lemishre basar hu daata.
Ever min hachay, dichtiv: "ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu". veiddach? hahu lemishre sheratzim hu daata.
Serus, dichtiv: "shirtzu vaaretz urevu vah". veiddach? livracha bealma.
Kilayim, dichtiv: "mehaof leminehu". veiddach? hahu letzavta bealma.
Amar rav yosef: amri be rav, al shalosh mitzvot ben noach neherag (gesher siman) – al gilluy arayot, veal shefichut damim, veal birkat hashshem.
Matkef la rav sheshet: bishlama shefichut damim, dichtiv "shofech dam haadam vegomer", ella hanach mena lehu?
I gamar mishshefichut damim, afillu kullehu name. i mishshum deitrabbay meish ish", avoda zara name itrabbay meish ish".
Ella amar rav sheshet: amri be rav, al arba mitzvot ben noach neherag.

Veal avoda zara ben noach neherag? vehatanya: baavoda zara, devarim shebbet din shel yisrael memitin alehen – ben noach muzehar alehen. azhara – in, mita – la! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: azhara shellahen – zo hi mitatan.
Rav huna verav yehuda vechullehu talmide derav amri: al sheva mitzvot ben noach neherag. galli rachamana bachada, vehu haddin lechullehu.
Veal haggazel ben noach neherag? vehatanya: al haggazel, ganav vegazal, vechen yefat toar, vechen kayyotze bahen – goy begoy vegoy beyisrael asur, veyisrael begoy muttar. veim ita, nitne "chayyayv"!
Mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa: "yisrael begoy muttar", tena resha: "asur".
Veha kol hecha deit leh chiyyuva mitna katane, dekatane resha: al shefichut damim – goy begoy vegoy beyisrael chayyayv, yisrael begoy patur.
Hatam, hechi litne? litne "asur" umuttar"? vehatanya: goy, veroe behema dakka – lo maalin velo moridin.
Kayyotze bo begazel, may hi? amar rav acha bar yaakov: lo nitzrecha ella lefoel bakkerem.
Poel bakkerem emat? i bishat gemar melacha – hettera hu, i lav bishat gemar melacha – gazel mealleya hu.
Ella amar rav pappa: lo nitzrecha ella lefachot mishshave peruta. i hachi, goy beyisrael asur? ha bar mechila hu! nehi devatar hachi machel leh, tzaara beshateh mi let leh?
Goy begoy kayyotze bahen, kevan delav bene mechila ninhu – gazel mealleya hu.
Ella, amar rav acha bereh derav ika: lo nitzrecha ella lechovesh sechar sachir. goy begoy vegoy beyisrael – asur; yisrael begoy – muttar.
Kayyotze bifat toar, may hi? ki ata rav dimi, amar: rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: ben noach sheyyiched shifcha leavdo uva aleha – neherag aleha.

Kayyotze bo dishfichut damim la tanya. amar abbaye: i mashkachat detanya, rabbi yonatan ben shaul hi. detanya, rabbi yonatan ben shaul omer: rodef achar chavero lehorgo, veyachol lehatztzilo beechad meevarav velo hitztzil -
b: Neherag alav.

Ashkach rabbi yaakov bar acha dahava ketiv besefer aggadta deve rav: ben noach neherag bedayyayn echad, uveed echad, shello behateraa, mippi ish velo mippi ishsha, vaafillu karov. mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: af al haubbarin.
Menahane mille? amar rav yehuda: deamar kera, "ach et dimchem lenafshotechem edrosh", afillu bedayyayn echad.
"Miyyad kol chayya", afillu shello behateraa. "edreshennu umiyyad haadam", afillu beed echad. "miyyad ish", velo miyyad ishsha. "achiv", afillu karov.
Mishshum rabbi yishmael amru: af al haubbarin. may tameh derabbi yishmael? dichtiv: "shofech dam haadam baadam damo yishshafech". ezehu adam shehu baadam? heve omer: ze ubbar shebbime immo.

Vetanna kamma tanna deve menashshe hu, deamar: kol mita haamura livne noach eno ella chenek, ushedi leh hay "baadam" assefeh dikra, uderosh beh hachi: "baadam damo yishshafech" – ezehu shefichut damim shel adam shehu begufo shel adam? heve omer: ze chenek.
Metiv rav hamenuna: veishsha la mippakda? vehachtiv: "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve vegomer"!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: "banav" – ledin, "beto" – litzdaka.
Amar leh rav avya sava lerav pappa: ema bat noach sheharga lo tehareg, "miyyad ish", velo "miyyad ishsha" ketiv? amar leh: hachi amar rav yehuda: "shofech dam haadam" – mikkol makom.
Ema: bat noach shezzinneta lo tehareg, dichtiv "al ken yaazov ish" velo ishsha? amar leh: hachi amar rav yehuda: "vehayu levasar echad" – hadar arvinhu kera.
Tanu rabbanan: "ish", ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot et haggoyim, shemmuzeharin al haarayot keyisrael.
Veha mehacha nafka? mehatam nafka! "lemor" – ze gilluy arayot.
Hatam baarayot didhu, vehacha baarayot didan, dekatane sefa: ba al arayot yisrael – niddon bedine yisrael.
Lemay hilcheta? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo nitzrecha ella laeda, veedim, vehateraa.
Migra gara?
Ella amar rav yochanan: lo nitzrecha ella lenaara hameorasa, dildidhu let lehu, dedayyninan lehu bedina didan.
Aval eshet ish, bedina didhu dayyninan lehu? vehatanya: ba al naara hameorasa – niddon biskila, al eshet ish – niddon bechenek. vei bedina didhu, sayif hu!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may eshet ish dekatane? kegon shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala, dildidhu let lehu. dayyninan lehu bedina didan.
Detane rabbi chanina: beulat baal – yesh lahen, nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala – en lahen.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: kol erva shebbet din shel yisrael memitin aleha – ben noach muzehar aleha. en bet din shel yisrael memitin aleha – en ben noach muzehar aleha. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: harebe arayot yesh sheen bet din shel yisrael memitin alehen, uven noach muzehar alehen.
Ba al arayot yisrael – niddon bedine yisrael. ba al arayot ben noach – niddon bedine ben noach. veanu en lanu ella naara hameorasa bilvad.
Venichshov name nichnesa lechuppa velo nivala? hay tanna tanna deve menashshe hu, deamar: kol mita haamura livne noach eno ella chenek. idde veidde chenek hu.
Vesavar rabbi meir: kol erva shebbet din shel yisrael memitin aleha, ben noach muzehar aleha? veha tanya: ger

a: Shehayta horato shello bikdushsha, veledato bikdushsha – yesh lo sheer haem, veen lo sheer haav.
Ha ketzad? nasa achoto min haem – yotzi, min haav – yekayyem. achot haav min haem – yotzi, min haav – yekayyem.

Achot haem min haem – yotzi. achot haem min haav, rabbi meir omer: yotzi, vachachamim omrim: yekayyem. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol erva shehi mishshum sheer em – yotzi, mishshum sheer haav – yekayyem.
Umuttar beeshet achiv, uveeshet achi aviv, ushear kol arayot muttarot lo. leetoye eshet aviv.
Nasa ishsha uvittah, kones achat umotzi achat. ulechattechilla lo yichnos. meta ishto, muttar bachamoto. veikka deamri: asur bachamoto.
Amar rav yehuda: la kashya, ha rabbi meir allibba derabbi eliezer, veha rabbi meir allibba derabbi akiva.
Detanya: "al ken yaazov ish et aviv veet immo". rabbi eliezer omer: "aviv" – achot aviv, "immo" – achot immo. rabbi akiva omer: "aviv" – eshet aviv, "immo" – immo mammash.
"Vedavak" – velo bezachar. "beishto" – velo beeshet chavero. "vehayu levasar echad" – mi shennaasim basar echad, yatzu behema vechayya sheen naasin basar echad.
Amar mar: rabbi eliezer omer "aviv" – achot aviv. ema: aviv mammash? hayeynu "vedavak", velo bezachar.
Ema: eshet aviv? hayeynu "beishto" velo beeshet chavero. ema: leachar mita? dumeya deimmo: ma immo delav ishut, af aviv delav ishut.
"Immo" – achot immo. veema immo mammash? hayeynu beishto velo beeshet chavero. veema leachar mita? dumeya deaviv: ma aviv delav mammash, af immo delav mammash.
Rabbi akiva omer: "aviv" – eshet aviv. veema: aviv mammash? hayeynu "vedavak" – velo bezachar. i hachi, eshet aviv name hayeynu "beishto" velo beeshet chavero! leachar mita.
"Immo" – immo mammash. hayeynu "beishto" velo beeshet chavero! immo meanusato.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi eliezer savar:
b: Aviv dumeya deimmo, veimmo dumeya deaviv. la mashkachat la ella beachvav.
Verabbi akiva: mutav leokmeh beeshet aviv, deikkeray "ervat aviv", leappoke achot aviv, disher aviv" ikkeray, "ervat aviv" la ikkeray.
Ta shema: "vayyikkach amram et yocheved dodato". may lav, dodato min haem?
Lo, dodato min haav.
Ta shema: "vegam omna achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi" – mikkelal devat haem asura.
Vetisbera achoto havay? bat achiv havay! vechevan dehachi hu, la shena min haav vela shena min haem – sharya. ella hatam hachi kaamar leh: kureba deachot it li bahada, meabba vela meimma.
Ta shema: mippene ma lo nasa adam et bitto? kede sheyyissa kayin et achoto, shenneemar: "ki amarti olam chesed yibbane". ha lav hachi – asira.
Kevan deishteray, ishteray.
Amar rav huna: goy muttar bevitto. veem tomar: mippene ma lo nasa adam et bitto? kede sheyyissa kayin et achoto, mishshum "olam chesed yibbane".
Veikka deamri: amar rav huna, goy asur bevitto. tidda, shello nasa adam et bitto. vela hi, hatam hayeynu tama: kede sheyyissa kayin et achoto, mishshum deolam chesed yibbane".
Amar rav chisda: eved muttar beimmo, umuttar bevitto. yatza mikkelal goy, velichlal yisrael lo ba.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: ben noach sheyyiched shifcha leavdo, uva aleha – neherag aleha.
Meemat? amar rav nachman: middekaru la "revita diflanya". meemat hattaratah? amar rav huna: mishsheppara roshah bashshuk.
Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: ben noach shebba al ishto shello kedarkah – chayyayv, shenneemar: "vedavak", velo shello kedarkah.
Amar rava: mi ikka midde deyisrael la michayyayv, venochri michayyayv?
Ella amar rava: ben noach shebba al eshet chavero shello kedarkah – patur. may tama? "beishto" – velo beeshet chavero; "vedavak" – vela shello kedarkah.
Amar rabbi chanina: goy shehikka et yisrael chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "vayyifen ko vacho vayyar ki en ish [vayyach et hammitzri] vegomer".
Veamar rabbi chanina: hassoter loo shel yisrael keillu soter loo shel shechina, shenneemar: "mokesh adam yala kodesh".

Magbiah, avdo, shavat – siman. amar resh lakish: hammagbiah yado al chavero, af al pi shello hikkahu, nikra rasha, shenneemar: "vayyomer larasha lamma takke reecha". "lamma hikkita" lo neemar, ella "lamma takke" – af al pi shello hikkahu nikra rasha.
Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: nikra chote, shenneemar: "veim lo lakachti vechozka", uchetiv: "vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod".
Rav huna amar: tikkatzetz yado, shenneemar: "uzeroa rama tishshaver". rav huna katz yeda.
Rabbi elazar omer: en lo takkana ella kevura, shenneemar: "veish zeroa lo haaretz".
Veamar rabbi elazar: lo nittena karka ella levaale zeroot, shenneemar: "veish zeroa lo haaretz".
Veamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "oved admato yisba lachem"? im ose adam atzmo keeved laadama – yisba lechem, veim lav – lo yisba lechem.
Veamar resh lakish: nochri sheshshavat chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "veyom valayla lo yishbotu". veamar mar: azhara shellahen zo hi mitatan. amar ravina: afillu sheni bashshabbat.
Velichsheva gabbe sheva mitzvot? ki ka chashev – shev veal taase, kum ase la ka chashev.

a: Veha dinin kum ase hu, veka chashev? kum ase veshev al taase ninhu.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: goy sheosek battora chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "tora tzivva lanu moshe morasha", lanu morasha velo lahem.
Velichsheva gabbe sheva mitzvot? man deamar "morasha" – migzal ka gazel la. man deamar "meorasa" – dino kenaara hameorasa, deviskila.

Metivi, haya rabbi meir omer: minnayin sheafillu goy veosek battora shehu kechohen gadol? shenneemar: "asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem". "kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim" lo neemar, ella "haadam". ha lamadta sheafillu goy veosek battora hare hu kechohen gadol.
Hatam, besheva mitzvot didhu.
Rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: af haddam min hachay. tanu rabbanan: "ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu" – ze ever min hachay. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: af haddam min hachay.
May tama derabbi chanina ben gamliel? keri beh: "basar benafsho lo tochel", "damo benafsho lo tochel". verabbanan? hahu lemishre sheratzim hu daata.
Keyotze baddavar atta omer: "rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh vegomer". "rak chazak levilti achol haddam" – ze ever min hachay, "ki haddam hu hannafesh" – ze dam min hachay.
Verabbanan, hahu ledam hakkaza shehanneshama yotza bo hu daata.
Lema li lemichtav livne noach, ulema li lemishne besinay?
Kidrabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol mitzva shenneemra livne noach venishnet besinay – laze velaze neemra.
Livne noach, velo nishnet besinay – leyisrael neemra velo livne noach. veanu en lanu ella gid hannashe, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Amar mar: kol mitzva shenneemra livne noach venishnet besinay, laze velaze neemra. adderabba, middenishnet besinay – leyisrael neemra velo livne noach!
Middeittenay avoda zara besinay, veashkechan daanash goyim illavav, shema minna: laze velaze neemra.
Livne noach, velo nishnet besinay – leyisrael neemra velo livne noach. adderabba, middelo nishnet besinay – livne noach neemra vela leyisrael! lekka middaam dilyisrael shere ulegoy asir.
Vela? vahare yefat toar! hatam, mishshum delav bene chibbush ninhu.
Vahare pachot mishshave peruta! hatam, mishshum delav bene mechila ninhu.
Kol mitzva shenneemra livne noach venishnet besinay, laze velaze neemra.
b: Vahare mila, shenneemra livne noach, dichtiv: "veatta et beriti tishmor", venishnet besinay: "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol" – leyisrael neemra velo livne noach.
Hahu lemishre shabbat hu daata, "bayyom" – vaafillu beshabbat.
Vahare periyya ureviyya, shenneemra livne noach, dichtiv: "veattem peru urevu", venishnet besinay: "lech emor lahem shuvu lachem leoholechem" – leyisrael neemra velo livne noach!
Hahu, lechol davar shebbeminyan tzarich minyan acher lehattiro hu daata.
I hachi, kol chada vachada name nema mishshum milleta ittenay?
Hachi kaamar: azhara mihdar umitna ba, lema li?
Veen lanu ella gid hannashe bilvad, veallibba derabbi yehuda. hane name la ittenay.
Hane ittenay leshum milleta bealma, ha la ittenay kelal.
I baet ema: mila meikkara leavraham hu deka mazhar leh rachamana, "veatta et beriti tishmor atta vezaracha acharecha ledorotam". "atta vezaracha" – in, inish acharina – la.
Ella meatta, bene yishmael lichayyeyvu? "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara".
Bene esav lichayyeyvu. "beyitzchak" – velo kol yitzchak.
Matkef la rav oshaya: ella meatta, bene ketura la lichayyeyvu? haamar rabbi yose bar avin, veittema rabbi yose bar chanina: "et beriti hefar" – lerabbot bene ketura.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: adam harishon lo huttar lo basar laachila, dichtiv: "lachem yihye leochla ulechol chayyat haaretz", velo chayyat haaretz lachem.

Ucheshebbau bene noach, hittir lahem, shenneemar: "keyerek esev natatti lachem et kol". yachol lo yehe ever min hachay noheg bo? talmud lomar: "ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu". yachol af lishratzim? talmud lomar: "ach".
Umay talmuda? amar rav huna: "damo" – mi sheddamo chaluk mibbesaro, yatzu sheratzim sheen damam chaluk mibbesheram.
Metivi: "uredu bidgat hayyam", may lav, laachila? lo, limlacha.
Vedagim bene melacha ninhu? in, kidrachava. devae rachava: hinhig beizza veshibbuta – may?
Ta shema: "uveof hashshamayim", may lav, laachila? la, limlacha.
Veofot bene melacha ninhu? in, kidvae rabba bar rav huna: dash baavavzin vetarnegolin lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda may?
Ta shema: "uvechol chayya haromeset al haaretz". hahu leetoye nachash hu daata.

Detanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: chaval al shammash gadol sheavad min haolam, sheilmale lo nitkallel nachash, kol echad veechad miyyisrael hayu mizdammenin lo shene nechashim tovim – echad meshaggero latztzafon veechad meshaggero laddarom, lehavi lo sandalbonim tovim vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot. velo od, ella shemmafshilin retzua tachat zenavo umotzi bah afar leginnato ulechurebato.

Metivi, haya rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: adam harishon mesev began eden haya, vehayu malache hashsharet tzolin lo basar umesannenin lo yayin. hetzitz bo nachash veraa bichvodo, venitkanne bo. hatam bevasar hayyored min hashshamayim.

Mi ikka basar hayyored min hashshamayim? in, ki ha derabbi shimon ben chalafta hava kaazel beorcha, pegau beh hanach aryavata dahavo ka nahami leappeh. amar: "hakkefirim shoagim lattaref". nechitu leh tarte atmata. chada achluha vachada shavkuha. ayteya vaata leve midresha, bae ala: davar tame hu ze o davar tahor? amaru leh: en davar tame yored min hashshamayim.
Bae minneh rabbi zera merabbi avahu: yarda lo demut chamor, mahu? amar leh: yarud nala! ha amri leh: en davar tame yored min hashshamayim.
Rabbi shimon omer: af al hakkishshuf. may tameh derabbi shimon? dichtiv:

a: "Mechashshefa lo techayye", uchetiv: "kol shochev im behema mot yumat". kol sheyyeshno bichlal "kol shochev im behema" – yeshno bichlal "mechashshefa lo techayye".
Rabbi elazar omer: af al hakkilayim. mena hane mille? amar shemuel, deamar kera: "et chukkotay tishmoru" – chukkim shechakakti lecha kevar: "behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim sadcha lo tizra kilayim".
Ma behemtecha beharebaa, af sadcha beharekava. ma behemtecha ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz, af sadcha ben baaretz ben bechutza laaretz.
Ella meatta: "ushemartem et chukkotay veet mishpatay" – chukkim shechakakti lecha kevar?
Hatam – "ushemartem et chukkotay" dehashta. hacha – "et chukkotay tishmoru", chukkim demeikkara tishmoru.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha kulei.
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: eno chayyayv ad sheyyevarech shem ben arba otiyyot, leappoke ben shete otiyyot dela.
Peshita! "yakke yosi et yosi" tenan! mahu detema: milleta bealma hu denaket, ka mashma lan.
Ikka deamri: amar rav acha bar yaakov, shema minna: shem ben arba otiyyot name shem hu.
Peshita! "yakke yosi et yosi" tenan! mahu detema: ad deikka shem rabba, umilleta bealma hu denaket – ka mashma lan.
Nigmar haddin kulei.

Omdin – menalan? amar rabbi yitzchak bar amme: deamar kera, "veehud ba elav vehu yoshev baaliyyat hammekera asher lo levaddo vayyomer ehud devar elohim li elecha vayyakom meal hakkisse". vahalo devarim kal vachomer? uma eglon melech moav shehu goy velo yada ella bechinnuy – amad, yisrael veshem hameforash – al achat kamma vechamma!
Korin – menalan? dichtiv: "vayyavo elyakim ben chilkiyyahu [vegomer] veshevna hassofer veyoach ben asaf hammazkir el chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim vayyaggidu lo et divre ravshake".
Velo meachin – menalan?

Amar rabbi avahu: atya keria keria, ketiv hacha "kerue vegadim", uchetiv hatam "veelisha roe vehu metzaek avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav velo raahu od vayyachazek bivgadav vayyikraem lishnayim keraim". mimmashma shenneemar "vayyikraem lishnayim", eni yodea shehen keraim? uma talmud lomar "keraim"? melammed shehen keruim leolam.
Tanu rabbanan: echad hashshomea, veechad shomea mippi shomea – chayyayv likroa. vehaedim en chayyayvin likroa, shekkevar karu beshaa sheshshamu.

Vechi karu beshaa sheshshamu, may have? ha ka shami hasheta! la salka datach, dichtiv: "vayhi kishmoa hammelech chizkiyyahu et divre ravshake vayyikra et begadav". hammelech chizkiyyahu kara, vehem lo karu.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hashshomea azkara mippi haggoy eno chayyayv likroa. veim tomar: ravshake – yisrael mumar haya.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en korin ella al shem hameyuchad bilvad, leappoke kinnuy dela.
Ufeligi derabbi chiyyay betarvayyhu, deamar rabbi chiyyay: hashshomea azkara bizman hazze eno chayyayv likroa, sheim i atta omer ken – nitmalle kol habbeged keraim.
Mimman? ilema miyyisrael, mi pekiri kulle hay? ella peshita, miggoy. vei shem hameyuchad, mi gemiri? ella lav, bechinnuy.
Ushema minna: bizman hazze hu dela, ha meikkara – chayyayv. shema minna.

Hashsheni omer: "af ani kamohu". amar resh lakish: shema minna, "af ani kamohu" kasher bedine mamonot uvedine nefashot, umaala hu daavud rabbanan. vehacha, kevan dela efshar, okmuha rabbanan addeorayyta.
Dei salka datach pasul, hacha, mishshum dela efshar, katlinan legavra?
Vehashshelishi omer: "af ani kamohu". setama kerabbi akiva, demakkesh shelosha lishnayim.
b: Mishna haoved avoda zara: echad haoved, veechad hamezabbeach, veechad hamekatter, veechad hamenassech, veechad hammishtachave, veechad hamekabbelo alav leeloah, vehaomer lo "eli atta".
Aval hamegappef, vehamenashshek, vehamechabbed, vehamerabbetz, vehamerachetz, vehassach, vehammalbish, vehammanil – over belo taase. hannoder bishmo, vehamekayyem bishmo – over belo taase.
Happoer atzmo levaal peor – zo hi avodatah. hazzorek even lemarkulis – zo hi avodatah.
Gemara may "echad haoved"?
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hachi kaamar, echad haoved kedarkah, veechad hamezabbeach, veechad hamekatter, veechad hamenassech, veechad hammishtachave, vaafillu shello kedarkah.
Velichshov name zorek? amar abbaye: zorek hayeynu menassech, dichtiv "bal assich niskehem middam".
Menahane mille?
Detanu rabbanan: illu neemar "zoveach yochoram", hayiti omer bezoveach kodashim bachutz hakkatuv medabber. talmud lomar "laelohim" – bezoveach laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber.
En li ella bezoveach, mekatter umenassech minnayin? talmud lomar: "bilti laAdonai levaddo". rikken haavodot kullan lashshem hameyuchad.
Lefi sheyyatza zevicha liddon baavodot penim, minnayin lerabbot hishtachavaa?
Talmud lomar: "vayyelech vayyaavod elohim acherim vayyishtachu lahem", usemich leh: "vehotzeta et haish hahu vegomer".
Onesh shamanu, azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "ki lo tishtachave leel acher".
Yachol sheani merabbe hamegappef vehamenashshek vehammanil? talmud lomar "zoveach".
Zevicha bakkelal hayta, velamma yatza? lehakkish eleha velomar lach: ma zevicha meyuchedet shehi avodat penim vechayyayvin aleha mita, af kol shehi avodat penim vechayyayvin aleha mita.
Yatza hishtachavaa liddon beatzmah, yatza zevicha liddon al hakkelal kullo.
Amar mar: hayiti omer bezoveach kodashim bachutz hakkatuv medabber. zoveach kodashim bachutz karet hu!
Salka datach amena: ki atro beh – ketala, ki la atro beh – karet. ka mashma lan.
Amar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye: ema, yatza hishtachavaa lelammed al hakkelal kullo.
Vechi tema: zoveach lema li? legufeh, dimchashshevin meavoda laavoda.
Deittemar: hashshochet behema lizrok damah laavoda zara ulehaktir chelbah laavoda zara, rabbi yochanan amar:

a: Asura, veresh lakish amar: mutteret.
Hanicha lerabbi yochanan, ella leresh lakish bae kera.
Matkef la rav pappa: ulerabbi yochanan la bae kera? ad kan la ka asar rabbi yochanan ella behema, aval gavra la bar ketala hu! vaata kera lechayyove gavra liktala.
Matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: uleresh lakish, mi bae kera? ad kan la ka share resh lakish ella behema, aval gavra bar ketala hu! midde dehave ammishtachave lehar, dehar muttar veovdo besayif.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: lemay dekaamar leh rava bar rav chanan leabbaye, ema yatza hishtachavaa lelammed al hakkelal kullo, "echa yaavdu" lemaote may?
Vechi tema: lemaote happoer atzmo lezovchim? mehishtachavaa nafka! ma hishtachavaa derech kibbud, af kol derech kibbud.
Ella, lemaote happoer atzmo lemarkulis. salka datach amena: hoil vaavodato bizzayon hu, af kol bizzayon? ka mashma lan.
Ella ha deamar rabbi eliezer: minnayin lazzoveach behema lemarkulis shehu chayyayv? shenneemar: "velo yizbechu od et zivchehem lasseirim".
Im eno inyan lichdarkah, dichtiv "echa yaavdu", tenehu inyan leshello kedarkah.
Shello kedarkah, mehishtachavaa nafka.
Hatam, bezoveach lehacheis.
Rav hamenuna irchasu leh tore. pega beh rabba, rema leh matneyatin ahadade: tenan "haoved avoda zara" – oved in, omer la. vehaanan tenan: "haomer 'eevod, 'elech veeevod, 'nelech venaavod"?
Amar leh: beomer "eni mekabbelo alay ella baavoda".
Rav yosef amar: tannae shaklat mealma? tannae hi, detanya: haomer "bou veivduni" – rabbi meir mechayyev, verabbi yehuda poter.
Hecha diflachu kulle alma – la peligi, dichtiv: "lo taase lecha fesel". ki peligi – bedibbura bealma. rabbi meir savar: dibbura milleta hi, verabbi yehuda savar: dibbura lav milleta hi.

Hadar amar rav yosef: lav milleta hi daamari, daafillu lerabbi yehuda bedibbura name chayyove mechayyev. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyomar "eevod", "elech veeevod", "nelech venaavod".
Bemay kamippalgi? bemesit leatzmo veamri leh "in" kamippalgi. mar savar, mesit leatzmo – shami leh, vein" dekaamri leh kusheta hu; umar savar, mesit leatzmo – la shami leh, memar amri:
b: May shena ihu minnan didan? vein" dekaamri, achoche aleh.
Umatneyatin: kan beyachid hannissat, kan berabbim hannissatim. yachid – la mimmelach, vetae batreh; rabbim – mimmalchi, vela tau batreh.
Amar rav yosef: mena amena la? dichtiv "lo tove lo velo tishma elav". ha ava veshama – chayyayv.

Etiveh abbaye: mi shane ben nissat derabbim lenissat yachid? vehatanya: "ki yesitcha achicha ven immecha" – echad yachid hannissat veechad rabbim hannissatim, vehotzi hakkatuv yachid mikkelal rabbim verabbim mikkelal yachid.
Yachid mikkelal rabbim, lehachemir al gufo ulehakel al mamono.
Rabbim mikkelal yachid, lehakel al gufam ulehachmir al mamonam.
Beha milleta hu deshane, aval bechol mille ki hadade ninhu.
Ella amar abbaye: kan – benissat mippi atzmo, kan – benissat mippi acherim. mippi atzmo – mimmelech, mippi acherim – gerir batrayyhu.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la? dichtiv: "lo tove lo velo tishma elav". ha ava veshama – chayyayv.
Rava amar: idde veidde benissat mippi acherim, ha daamar leh "kach ochelet", "kach shota", "kach metiva", "kach merea", ha dela amar leh "kach ochelet", "kach shota" kulei.

Amar rava: mena amena la? dichtiv: "meelohe haammim asher sevivotechem hakkerovim elecha vegomer". ma li kerovim uma li rechokim? hachi kaamar lach: mittivutan shel kerovim atta lamed ma tivutan shel rechokim.
May lav daamar leh: kach ochelet, kach shote, kach mittivah, kach merea? shema minna.
Rav ashe amar: sefa beyisrael meshummad.
Ravina amar: la zo af zo katane.
Ittemar: haoved avoda zara meahava umiyyira, abbaye amar: chayyayv, rava amar: patur.
Abbaye amar: chayyayv, deha palcha. rava amar: patur, i kabbelay aleh beeloah – in, i la – la.
Siman: eved yishtachave lemashiach.
Veamar abbaye: mena amena la? ditnan: haoved avoda zara, echad haoved kulei. may lav echad haoved meahava umiyyira?
Verava amar lach: la, kedimtaretz rabbi yirmeya.

Amar abbaye: mena amena la? detanya: "lo tishtachave lahem" – lahem i atta mishtachave, aval atta mishtachave leadam kemotcha. yachol afillu neevad kehaman? talmud lomar: "velo taovdem". veha haman miyyira hava neevad!
Verava: kehaman velo kehaman. kehaman – deihu gufeh avoda zara, velo kehaman – deillu haman miyyira, vehacha lav miyyira.
Veamar abbaye: mena amena la? detanya: kohen mashiach baavoda zara, rabbi omer: beshiggat maase, vachachamim omrim: behelem davar.
Veshavin, shebbisira keyachid. veshavin, sheen mevi asham taluy.
Hay shiggat maase daavoda zara, hechi dame? i kasavar bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lo, hare libbo lashshamayim! ella dachaza inderata vehishtachava lo.
I kabbeleh aleh beeloah – mezid hu.

a: Vei la kabbeleh aleh beeloah – la kelum hu. ella lav, meahava umiyyira?
Verava amar lach: la, beomer muttar.
Omer muttar, hayeynu helem davar!
Beomer muttar ligmare. helem davar – kiyyum miktzat uvittul miktzat.
Tane rabbi zakkay kammeh derabbi yochanan: zibbach, vekitter, venissech, vehishtachava behelem echad – eno chayyayv ella achat.
Amar leh: pok teni levara.
Amar rabbi abba: ha deamar rabbi zakkay machloket rabbi yose verabbi natan, detanya: haveara lelav yatzat, divre rabbi yose.
Verabbi natan omer: lechallek yatzat.
Leman deamar haveara lelav yatzat, hishtachavaa name lelav yatzat.
Leman deamar haveara lechallek yatzat, hishtachavaa name lechallek yatzat.
Matkef la rav yosef: dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yose hatam haveara lelav yatzat, denafka leh chilluk melachot meachat mehenna"?
Detanya: rabbi yose omer, "veasa meachat mehenna" – peamim shechayyayv achat al kullan, peamim shechayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Veamar rabbi yonatan: may tama derabbi yose? dichtiv "veasa meachat mehenna". "achat", "meachat". "henna", "mehenna". achat shehi henna, vehenna shehi achat.
"Achat" – "shimon", "meachat" – "shem" mishshimon".
"Henna" – avot, "mehenna" – toladot. "achat" shehi "henna": zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot. "henna" shehi "achat": shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot.
Aval hacha, dela nafka leh chilluk melachot midducheta achariti, dechulle alma hishtachavaa lechallek yatzat.
Chilluk melachot daavoda zara name tippok leh meachat mehenna"? "achat" – zevicha, "meachat" – siman echad.
"Henna" – avot: zibbuach, kittur, nissuch, vehishtachavaa. "mehenna" – toladot: shavar makkel lefaneha.
"Achat" shehi "henna": zedon avoda zara veshiggat avodot. "henna" shehi "achat": shiggat avoda zara uzedon avodot.
Hay shiggat avoda zara, hechi dame? i kasavar bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lo, hare libbo lashshamayim.
Ella dachaza inderata useged leh. i kabbeleh aleh – mezid hu, i la kabbeleh aleh – la kelum hu.
Ella meahava umiyyira. hanicha leabbayye, deamar chayyayv; ella lerava, deamar patur, may ikka lememar?
Ella beomer "muttar". tifshot diva minneh rava merav nachman: helem ze vaze beyado, mahu?
Tifshot, deeno chayyayv ella achat. ha la kashya, vetifshot.
Umi matzet mokmat lehane kerae baavoda zara? deillu hacha, ketiv: bemashiach – par, uvenasi – sair, uveyachid – kisba useira.
Veillu baavoda zara tenan: veshavin shebbisira keyachid.
Vetu la midde.
Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar:
b: Hachi tena kammeh: chomer bashshabbat mishshear mitzvot, chomer bishar mitzvot mibbashshabbat. chomer bashshabbat – shehashshabbat asa shetayim behelem echad, chayyayv al kol achat veachat, ma sheen ken bishar mitzvot. chomer bishar mitzvot – shebbishar mitzvot shagag belo mitkavven chayyayv, ma sheen ken bashshabbat.

Amar mar: chomer bashshabbat, shehashshabbat asa shetayim kulei. hechi dame? illema daavad ketzira utechina, dichvavta gabbe shear mitzvot – daachal chelev vadam. hacha tarte michayyayv, vehacha tarte michayyayv!
Ella, gabbe shear mitzvot deeno chayyayv ella achat, hechi dame? daachal chelev vachelev. dichvavta gabbe shabbat, daavad ketzira uketzira. hacha chada michayyayv, vehacha chada michayyayv.
Vehayeynu daamar leh: "pok teni levara!"

May kusheya? dilma leolam ema lecha daavad ketzira utechina, "ma sheen ken bishar mitzvot" atan laavoda zara kidrabbi amme, deamar rabbi amme: zibbach vekitter venissech behelem echad – eno chayyayv ella achat.
La mittokma leh baavoda zara, dekatane sefa: chomer bishar mitzvot, shebbishar mitzvot shagag belo mitkavven – chayyayv.

Shogeg belo mitkavven baavoda zara, hechi dame? i dekasavar bet hakkeneset hu vehishtachava lo, hare libbo lashshamayim. ella dachaza inderata useged leh. i kabbeleh aleh beeloah – mezid hu, vei la kabbeleh aleh – lo kelum hi.
Ella meahava umiyyira. hanicha leabbayye, deamar chayyayv. ella lerava, deamar patur, may ikka lememar?
Ella beomer muttar, ma sheen ken bashshabbat defatur ligmare.
Ad kan la bea minneh rava merav nachman helem ze vaze – ella i lechayyove chada, i lechayyove tarte. patur ligmare – lekka leman deamar.
May kusheya? dilma leolam ema lach: resha baavoda zara, vesefa bishar mitzvot.
Veshagag belo mitkavven, dekasavar rok hu uvelao. ma sheen ken bashshabbat, defatur. shennitkavven lehagebiah et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar – patur.
Vechidrav nachman amar shemuel, deamar: hammitassek bachalavim uvaarayot – chayyayv, shekken nehene; hammitassek beshabbat – patur, melechet machshevet asra tora.
Rabbi yochanan letameh, dela mokem matnita resha bechad tama vesefa bechad tama.
Deamar rabbi yochanan: man dimtargem li chavit allibba dechad tanna, movelna maneh batreh leve massuta.
Gufa,

a: Amar rabbi amme: zibbach vekitter venissech behelem echad, eno chayyayv ella achat. amar abbaye: may tama derabbi amme? amar kera "lo taovdem", hakkatuv asaan kullan avoda achat.
Umi amar abbaye hachi? vehaamar abbaye: shalosh hishtachavaot baavoda zara lamma?
Achat lichdarkah, veachat shello kedarkah, veachat lechallek.
Lidvarav derabbi amme kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.
Gufa, amar abbaye: shalosh hishtachavaot baavoda zara lamma? achat lichdarkah, veachat shello kedarkah, veachat lechallek.
Lichdarkah, meecha yaavdu haggoyim haelle" nafka.
Ella, achat kedarkah veshello kedarkah, veachat leshello kedarkah, veachat lechallek.
Hamekabbelo alav beeloah, haomer lo "eli atta". amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: kevan sheamar lo "eli atta" – chayyayv.
Lemay? i liktala, matnitin hi! ella lekorban.

Vaafillu lerabbanan? vehatanya: eno chayyayv ella al davar sheyyesh bo maase, kegon zibbuach vekittur venissuch vehishtachavaa. veamar resh lakish: man tena hishtachavaa? rabbi akiva hi, deamar la baenan maase. mikkelal derabbanan savri baenan maase.
Ki kaamar rav name, lerabbi akiva kaamar.
Lerabbi akiva, peshita! hayeynu megaddef.
Mahu detema: ad kan la mechayyev rabbi akiva korban ella bimgaddef, dichtiv beh karet. aval hacha, dela ketiv beh karet, ema la.
Ka mashma lan deittakkoshe ittakkush, dichtiv: "vayyishtachavu lo vayyizbechu lo vayyomru vegomer".
Amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale vav shebbeheelucha", nitchayyeyvu sonehem shel yisrael kelayay.
Ketannae: acherim omrim, ilmale vav shebbeheelucha", nitchayyeyvu sonehem shel yisrael kelayay.

Amar lo rabbi shimon ben yochay: vahalo kol hameshattef shem shamayim vedavar acher neekar min haolam, shenneemar "bilti laAdonai levaddo"! ella ma talmud lomar "asher heelucha"? sheiuu elohot harebe.
Aval hamegappef vehamenashshek, hamechabbed vehamerabbetz kulei. ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi elazar: al kullam loke, chutz mehannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo.
May shena hannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo dela lake? mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase. hane name lav shebbichlalot hu, veen lokin al lav shebbichlalot.
Detanya: minnayin leochel min habbehema kodem shettetze nafshah shehu belo taase? talmud lomar: "lo tochlu al haddam".
Davar acher: "lo tochlu al haddam" – lo tochlu basar, vaadayin dam bemizrak.
Rabbi dosa omer: minnayin sheen mavrin al haruge bet din? talmud lomar: "lo tochlu al haddam".
Rabbi akiva omer: minnayin lesanhedrin shehargu et hannefesh, sheen toamin kelum kol oto hayyom? talmud lomar: "lo tochlu al haddam".
Amar rabbi yochanan: azhara leven sorer umore minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo tochlu al haddam".
Veamar rabbi avin bar chiyyay, veittema rabbi avin bar kahana: al kullam eno loke, mishshum dehave leh lav shebbichlalot.
Ella, ki ata ravin amar rabbi elazar: al kullan eno loke, chutz min hannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo.
May shena ahanach dela lake? dehave leh lav shebbichlalot. hane name lav sheen bo maase ninhu.
Hahu kerabbi yehuda, deamar: lav sheen bo maase – lokin alav.
Detanya: "lo totiru mimmennu ad boker" – ba hakkatuv litten ase achar lo taase,
b: Lomar sheen lokin alav, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yaakov omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum dehave leh lav sheen bo maase, vechol lav sheen bo maase en lokin alav.
Mikkelal derabbi yehuda savar: lokin alav.
Hannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo, hare ze belo taase. hannoder bishmo vehamekayyem bishmo, menalan?

Detanya: "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru" – shello yomar adam lachavero "shemor li betzad avoda zara pelonit". "lo yishshama al picha" – shello yiddor bishmo velo yekayyem bishmo, velo yigrom laacherim shidderu bishmo vesheyyekayyeymu bishmo.
Davar acher: "lo yishshama al picha" – azhara lammesit velammaddiach.
Mesit, behedya ketiv beh: "vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau vegomer". ella, azhara lammaddiach.

Velo yigrom laacherim sheyyidderu bishmo vesheyyekayyeymu bishmo. mesayyeya leh laavu dishmuel, deamar avu dishmuel: asur leadam sheyyaase shuttafut im hannochri, shemma yitchayyev lo shevua venishba baavoda zara shello, vehattora amra: "lo yishshama al picha".

Ki ata ulla, bat bekalnevo. amar leh rava: vehecha bat mar? amar leh: bekalnevo. amar leh: vehachtiv "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru"? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: kol avoda zara hakketuva battora – muttar lehazekir shemah. veha hecha ketiva? dichtiv: "kara bel kores nevo".

Vei la ketiva – la? metiv rav mesharsheya: raa achat merubba keshalosh, shehi kemiggadyon leshilo, shehen shete tevilot ushene sefogin – hare ze zav gamur. amar ravina: gad name michtav ketiv, dichtiv "haorchim laggad shulchan".
Amar rav nachman: kol letzanuta asira, chutz milletzanuta daavoda zara desharya, dichtiv: "kara bel kores nevo ... karsu charu yachdav lo yachlu mallet massa".
Uchetiv: "dibberu ... leeglot bet aven yaguru shechan shomron ki aval alav ammo uchemarav alav yagilu al kevodo ki gala mimmennu". al tikre "kevodo", ella "kevedo".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "veatta yosifu lachato vayyasu lahem massecha mikkaspam kitvunam atzabbim vegomer" – may "kitvunam atzabbim"? melammed shekkol echad veechad ose demut yirato umannichah bechiso, beshaa shezzochrah motziah mittoch cheko umechabbekah umenashshekah.

May "zovche adam agalim yishshakun"? amar rabbi yitzchak deve rabbi amme: shehayu komarim notnim enehem bevaale mamon, umarivim et haagalim, veosin demut atzabbim, umaamidin betzad avusehen, umotziin otan lachutz. kevan sherau otan ratzin acharehen umemashmeshin bahen, omrim lo: avoda zara chafetz becha, yavo veyizbach atzmo lo.
Amar rava: hay "zovche adam agalim yishshakun"? "agalim yishshakun lizboach adam" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kol hazzoveach et beno laavoda zara, omer lo: doron gadol hikriv lo, yavo veyishshak lo.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: "veanshe vavel asu et sukkot benot", umay nihu? tarnegolet. "veanshe chut asu et nergal", umay nihu? tarnegol. "veanshe chamat asu et ashima", umay nihu? barcha karcha. "vehaavvim asu et nivchan veet tartak", umay nihu? kelev vachamor.

"Vehasefarvim sorfim et benehem veet benotehem baesh leadrammelech vaanammelech elohe sefarvayim", umay nihu? happered vehassus. adrammelech – deadar leh lemareh bitina, vaanammelech – deane leh lemareh bikrava.
Af chizkiyya melech yehuda bikkesh aviv laasot lo ken, ella shessachattu immo salamandera.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: yodin hayu yisrael baavoda zara sheen bah mammash, velo avdu avoda zara ella lehattir lahem arayot befarhesya.
Metiv rav mesharsheya: "kizkor benehem mizbechotam vegomer", veamar rabbi elazar: keadam sheyyesh lo gaguin al beno?
Batar daaviku bay.
Ta shema: "venatatti pigrechem al pigre gillulechem". amar: eliyyahu hatztzaddik haya mechazzer al tefuche raav shebbirushalayim. paam achat matza tinok shehaya tafuach umutal baashpa.

Amar lo: meeze mishpacha atta? amar lo: mimmishpacha pelonit ani. amar lo: kelum nishtayyer meotah mishpacha? amar lo: lav, chutz mimmenni. amar lo: im ani melammedcha davar sheatta chay bo, atta lamed? amar lo: hen. amar lo: emor bechol yom "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad". amar lo:

a: Has, shello lehazekir beshem Adonai, shello limmedo aviv veimmo.

Miyyad hotzi yirato mecheko, umechabbekah umenashshekah, ad shennivkea kereso venafla yirato laaretz, venafal hu aleha, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "venatatti et pigrechem al pigre gillulechem". batar daaviku beh.

Ta shema: "vayyizaku bekol gadol el Adonai elohehem". may amur? amar rav yehuda, veittema rav yonatan: biyyay, biyyay! hayeynu deachreveh leveta, vekalye lehechla, vekatlinhu letzaddike, veaglinhu leyisrael mearayyhu, vaadayin hu merakked benan. kelum yehavteh lan ella lekabbole beh agra? la ihu baenan vela agreh baenan! batar daaviku beh.
Yetavu telata yome betaanita, bau rachame. nefal lehu pitka merkia dahava ketiv ba: "emet".
Amar rabbi chanina: shema minna, chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu 'emet.

Nefak kegureya denura mibbet kadshe hakkodashim. amar lehu navi leyisrael: hayeynu yitzra daavoda zara. bahade dekatafsi leh, ishtemit binita minneh, vaazal kaleh bearba mea parse. amru: hechi nebed? dilma mishshemayya merachami aleh.
Amar lehu navi: shadyu beduda daavara, vechasseyu baavara, deshayef kaleh. dichtiv: "vayyomer zot harisha vayyashlech otah el toch haefa vayyashlech et haeven haoferet el piha".
Amri: hoil veet ratzon hu, nive rachame ayyitzra daavera. beo rachame, immesar bidayyhu.
Chavshu telata yome. beo beata bat yoma lechole, vela ashkachu. amaru: hechi naaved? nive palga? palga merkia la yahavi. kachlinhu leeneh. ahani beh dela miggare inish bekarivteh.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: maase begoya achat shehayta chola beyoter, amra: im taamod hahi ishsha mecholyah, telech vetaavod lechol avoda zara shebbaolam. amda veavda lechol avoda zara shebbaolam. kevan shehiggia lifor, shaala lakkomarim: bamma ovdin lazo? amru lah: ochlin teradin veshotin shechar umatrizin befaneha. amra: mutav shettachazor hahi ishsha lecholyah velo taavod avoda zara bechach.
Attem bet yisrael enan ken, "hannitzmadim levaal peor" – ketzamid patil, "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem" – kishte temarot haddevukot zo bazo.
Bematnita tana: "hannitzmadim levaal peor" – ketzamid al yede ishsha, "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem" – devukim mammash.

Tanu rabbanan: maase besavta ben allas, shehiskir chamoro legoya achat. kevan shehiggia lifor, amra lo: hameten ad sheekkanes veetze. leachar sheyyatza, amar lah: af at hametini ad sheekkanes veetze. amra lo: velo yehudi atta? amar lah: umay ichpat lich? nichnas, paar befanav vekinnach bechotmo. vehayu komarin mekallesin lo veomrim: meolam lo haya adam sheavado laze bechach.
Happoer atzmo levaal peor – hare ze avodato, af al gav demikkavven levizzuy. hazzorek even lemarkulis – zo hi avodato, af al gav demikkavven lemirgemeh.
Rav menashshe hava kaazel leve torta. amaru leh: avoda zara hi dekae hacha. shekal pissa, sheda bay. amru lo: markulis hi. amar lehu: "hazzorek even lemarkulis" tenan.

Ata sheal be midresha. amru lo: "hazzorek even bemarkulis" tenan, af al gav demikkavven lemirgemeh. amar lehu: ezil eshkela. amru lo: echad hannotlah veechad hannotnah chayyayv, kol chada vachada ravvcha lachaverta shavek.

Mishna hannoten mizzaro lammolech, eno chayyayv ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh. masar lammolech velo heevir baesh, heevir baesh velo masar lammolech – eno chayyayv ad sheyyimsor lammolech veyaavir baesh.

Gemara katane avoda zara, vekatane molech. amar rabbi avin: tenan keman deamar molech lav avoda zara hi, detanya: echad lammolech veechad lishar avoda zara – chayyayv. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lammolech – chayyayv, shello lammolech – patur.

Amar abbaye: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon verabbi chanina ben antignos amru davar echad. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon – ha daamaran. rabbi chanina ben antignos – detanya: rabbi chanina ben antignos omer, mippene ma tafsa tora leshon "molech"? kol shehimlichuhu alehem, afillu tzeror vaafillu kesam.
Rava amar: molech aray ikka benayyhu.
b: Amar rabbi yannay: eno chayyayv ad sheyyimserennu lechomarin, shenneemar: "umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech".

Tanya name hachi: yachol heevir velo masar yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar "lo titten". masar lammolech velo heevir, yachol yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar "lehaavir". masar veheevir shello lammolech, yachol yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar "lammolech".

Masar veheevir lammolech, velo baesh – yachol yehe chayyayv? neemar kan "lehaavir", veneemar lehallan "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh". ma lehallan baesh, af kan baesh. uma kan molech, af lehallan molech.
Amar rav acha bereh derava: heevir kol zaro – patur, shenneemar "mizzaracha" – velo kol zaracha.
Bae rav ashe: heeviro some, mahu? yashen, mahu? ben beno uven bitto, mahu?

Tifshot miha chada, detanya: "ki mizzaro natan lammolech" – ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "lo yimmatze vecha maavir beno uvitto baesh", en li ella beno uvitto. ben beno uven bitto minnayin? talmud lomar: "betitto mizzaro".
Tanna patach beki mizzaro", vesalek betitto mizzaro".
Derasha acharina hu: "zaro" – en li ella zera kasher, zera pasul minnayin? talmud lomar "betitto mizzaro".
Amar rav yehuda: eno chayyayv ad sheyyaavirennu derech haavara. hechi dame? amar abbaye: sheraga delivne bemitze, nura mehay gisa venura mehay gisa.
Rava amar: kemashvavrta defurayya.
Tanya kevavteh derava: eno chayyayv ad sheyyaavirennu derech avarah. heeviro baregel – patur.
Veeno chayyayv ella al yotze yerecho. ha ketzad? beno uvitto – chayyayv, aviv veimmo achiv vaachoto – patur. heevir atzmo – patur, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mechayyev.
Echad lammolech, veechad lishar avoda zara – chayyayv. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lammolech – chayyayv, shello lammolech – patur.
Amar ulla: may tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon? amar kera: "lo yimmatze vecha" – becha beatzmecha.
Verabbanan la darshi "becha"? vehatnan: avedato vaavedat aviv – shello kodemet. veamrinan: may tama? veamar rav yehuda: amar kera "efes ki lo yihye becha evyon" – shello kodemet leshel kol adam.
Hatam meefes".
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: shalosh karetot baavoda zara lamma?
Achat lichdarkah, veachat leshello kedarkah, veachat lammolech.
Uleman deamar molech avoda zara hi, karet bemolech lema li? lemaavir beno shello kedarkah.
Uleman deamar: megaddef avoda zara hi, karet bimgaddef lema li?
Lechidtanya: "hikkaret tikkaret". "hikkaret" – baolam hazze, "tikkaret" – laolam habba, divre rabbi akiva.
Amar lo rabbi yishmael: vahalo kevar neemar "venichreta"! vechi shelosha olamim yesh? ella "venichreta" – baolam hazze, "hikkaret" – laolam habba, "tikkaret" – dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.

a: Mishna baal ov – ze pitom hamedabber mishshechyo, veyiddeoni – ze hamedabber befiv. hare ellu biskila, vehannishal bahem beazhara.
Gemara may shena hacha dekatane baal ov veyiddeoni, umay shena gabbe karetot dekatane baal ov veshayyeyreh leyiddeoni?
Rabbi yochanan amar: hoil ushenehen belav echad neemru.
Resh lakish amar: yiddeoni, lefi sheen bo maase.
Verabbi yochanan, may shena baal ov denaket? mishshum diftach beh kera.
Veresh lakish, may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan? amar rav pappa: chalukin hen bemita.
Verabbi yochanan: chalukka delav – shemah chalukka, demita – lo shemah chalukka.
Verabbi yochanan, may tama la amar keresh lakish? amar lach: matnitin decharetot rabbi akiva hi, deamar: la baenan maase.
Veresh lakish: nehi dela bae rabbi akiva maase rabba, maase zuta bae.
Megaddef, may maase ikka? akimat sefatav have maase.
Baal ov, may maase ikka? hakkashat zerootav have maase.
Vaafillu lerabbanan? vehatanya: eno chayyayv ella al davar sheyyesh bo maase, kegon zibbuach, kittur, venissuch, vehishtachavaa.
Veamar resh lakish: man tena hishtachavaa? rabbi akiva hi, deamar: la baenan maase. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan, kefifat komato lerabbanan have maase.
Hasheta leresh lakish, kefifat komato lerabbanan la have maase, hakkashat zerootav devaal ov have maase?
Ki kaamar resh lakish name – lerabbi akiva, aval lerabbanan – la.
I hachi, yatza megaddef uvaal ov mibbee leh!
Ella amar ulla: bimkatter lashshed.
Amar leh rava: mekatter lashshed – oved avoda zara hu! ella, amar rava: bimkatter lechabbar.
Amar leh abbaye: hamekatter lechabbar – chover chaver hu.
In, vehattora amra: chover ze biskila.
Tanu rabbanan: "chover chaver" – echad chever gadol veechad chever katan, vaafillu nechashim veakrabbim.
Amar abbaye: hilkach, hay man detzamed zibbura veakrabba, af al gav deka mikkavven dela layzzeku, asur.
Verabbi yochanan, may shena dichfifat komato lerabbanan have maase, vaakimat sefatav la have maase?
Amar rava: shane megaddef, hoil veyeshno ballev.
b: Metiv rabbi zera: yatzu edim zommin, sheen bahen maase. veammay? ha letanhu ballev!
Amar rava: shane edim zommin, hoil veyeshno bekol.
Vekol, lerabbi yochanan, lav maase hu? veha ittemar: chasamah bekol vehinhigah bekol, rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, veresh lakish amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, akimat piv have maase. resh lakish amar: patur, akimat piv la have maase.
Ella amar rava: shane edim zommin, hoil veyeshnan biriyya.
Tanu rabbanan: baal ov – ze hamedabber ben happerakim umibben atztzile yadav. yiddeoni – ze hammanniach etzem yadua befiv, vehu medabber meelav.
Metivi: "vehaya keov meeretz kolech". may lav, demishtae ki orcheh? la, desalek veyatev ben happerakim umishtae.
Ta shema: "vattomer haishsha el shaul elohim raiti olim min haaretz". may lav, demishtae ki orcheh? la, deyatev ben happerakim umishtae.

Tanu rabbanan: baal ov – echad hammaale bizchuro, veechad hannishal begulegolet. ma ben ze laze? maale bizchuro – eno ole kedarko, veeno ole bashshabbat. nishal begulegolet – ole kedarko, veole bashshabbat.
Ole? lehecha salek? ha kammeh mannach! ella ema: one kedarko, veone bashshabbat.
Veaf sheela zo shaal toranuserufus harasha et rabbi akiva. amar lo: uma yom miyyamim? amar lo: uma gevar migguverin? amar leh: demari tzave. shabbat name demari tzave.

Amar leh, hachi kaamena lach: mi yemar dehaiddana shabbeta? amar lo: nehar sabbatyon yochiach, baal ov yochiach, kivro shel aviv yochiach, sheen maale ashan bashshabbat. amar lo: bizzito, biyyayshto, vekillalto!
Shoel ov, hayeynu "vedoresh el hammetim"!
Doresh lammetim, kidtanya: "vedoresh el hammetim" – ze hammariv atzmo veholech velan bevet hakkevarot, kede shettishre alav ruach tumea.

Ucheshehaya rabbi akiva maggia lemikra ze haya boche, uma hammariv atzmo keday shettishre alav ruach tumea – shora alav ruach tumea, hammariv atzmo keday shettishre alav ruach tohora – al achat kamma vechamma. aval ma eese sheavonotenu garmu lanu, shenneemar: "ki [im] avonotechem hayu mavdilim benechem leven elohechem".
Amar rava: i bau tzaddike, baru alma, shenneemar: "ki avonotechem hayu mavdilim vegomer".
Rava bera gavra. shaddereh lekammeh derabbi zera. hava ka mishtae bahadeh, vela hava ka mahdar leh. amar leh: min chavrayya at, hadar leafraych.
