Rav chanina verav oshaya havo yatvi kol maale shabbeta, veaski besefer yetzira, umibbere lehu igla tilta, veachli leh.

Tanu rabbanan: "meonen" – rabbi shimon omer: ze hammaavir shiva mine zechur al haayin. vachachamim omrim: ze haochez et haenayim. rabbi akiva omer: ze hamechashshev ittim veshaot veomer "hayyom yafe latzet", "lemachar yafe likkach", "limmude arve sheviiyyot chittin yafot", "ikkure kitniyyot meheyot raot".
Tanu rabbanan: "menachesh" – ze haomer: "pitto nafla mippiv", "maklo nafla middo", "beno kore lo meacharav", "orev kore lo", "tzevi hifsiko badderech", "nachash mimino", veshual missemolo".

a: "Al tatchil bi", "shacharit hu", "rosh chodesh hu", "motzae shabbat hu".
Tanu rabbanan: "lo tenachashu velo teonenu" – kegon ellu hamenachashim bechuleda, beofot, uvedagim.
Mishna hamechallel et hashshabbat bedavar shechayyayvin al zedono karet, veal shiggato chattat.
Gemara mikkelal deikka midde dechillul shabbat have, veen chayyayvin lo al shiggato chattat velo al zedono karet.
May hi? techumin, veallibba derabbi akiva. haveara, veallibba derabbi yose.
Mishna hamekallel aviv veimmo eno chayyayv ad sheyyekallelem bashshem. killelam bechinnuy, rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin.

Gemara man chachamim? rabbi menachem berabbi yose hu. detanya: rabbi menachem berabbi yose omer, "benokvo shem yumat" – ma talmud lomar "shem"? limmed al mekallel aviv veimmo sheeno chayyayv ad sheyyekallelem bashshem.
Tanu rabbanan: "ish" – ma talmud lomar "ish ish"? lerabbot bat, tumetum, veanderoginos.

"Asher yekallel et aviv veet immo" – en li ella aviv veimmo. aviv shello immo, immo shello aviv – minnayin? talmud lomar: "aviv veimmo killel damav bo" – aviv killel, immo killel. divre rabbi yoshiyya.
Rabbi yonatan omer: mashma shenehen keechad, umashma echad bifne atzmo, ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv "yachdav".
"Mot yumat" – biskila. atta omer biskila, o eno ella beachat mikkol mitot haamurot battora? neemar kan "damav bo", veneemar lehallan "demehem bam". ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila.

Onesh shamanu, azhara minnayin? talmud lomar: "elohim lo tekallel vegomer". im haya aviv dayyayn – hare hu bichlal "elohim lo tekallel", veim haya aviv nasi – hare hu bichlal "venasi veammecha lo taor".
Eno lo dayyayn velo nasi, minnayin? amrat: hare atta dan binyan av mishshenehen. lo rei nesi kiri dayyayn, velo rei dayyayn kiri nasi.

Lo rei dayyayn kiri nasi, shehare dayyayn – atta metzuvvev al horaato, kiri nasi – shei atta metzuvvev al horaato. velo rei nasi kiri dayyayn, shehannasi – atta metzuvvev al hameraato, kiri dayyayn – shei atta metzuvvev al hameraato.
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahem shehen beammecha, veatta muzehar al killatan. af ani avi avicha, shebbeammecha, veatta muzehar al killato.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken gedullatan garma lahen?
Talmud lomar: "lo tekallel cheresh" – beumelalim shebbeammecha hakkatuv medabber.
Ma lecheresh, shekken charishato garma lo?
Nasi vedayyayn yochichu. ma lenasi vedayyayn shekken gedullatan garma lahen? cheresh yochiach.
Vechazar haddin. lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: shehen beammecha, veatta muzehar al killatan. af ani avi avicha, shebbeammecha veatta muzehar al killato.
Ma letzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken meshunnin?
Ella, im ken nichtov kera: o "elohim vecheresh", o "nasi vecheresh". "elohim" lema li? im eno inyan legufo, tenehu inyan leaviv.
Hanicha leman deamar "elohim" chol, ella leman deamar kodesh, may ikka lememar?
Detanya: "elohim" – chol, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: "elohim" – kodesh. vetanya: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: azhara limvarech et hashshem minnayin? talmud lomar: "elohim lo tekallel".
Leman deamar "elohim" chol – gamar kodesh mechol, leman deamar "elohim" kodesh – gamrinan chol mikkodesh.
Bishlama leman deamar "elohim" chol, gamar kodesh mechol. ella leman deamar "elohim" kodesh, gamar chol mikkodesh? dilma akkodesh azhar, achol la azhar?
Im ken, lichtov kera: "lo takel"!
b: May "lo tekallel"? shema minna tarte.
Mishna habba al naara hameorasa eno chayyayv, ad shettehe naara, betula, meorasa, vehi bevet aviha. bau aleha shenayim, harishon biskila vehashsheni bechenek.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "naara" – velo bogeret, "betula" – velo beula, "meorasa" – velo nesua, "bevet aviha" – perat leshemmasar haav lishluche habbaal.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: naara hameorasa – afillu ketanna bammashma.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: mimmay dematnitin rabbi meir hi, ulemaote ketanna name? dilma rabbanan hi, ulemaote bogeret vetu la?
Amar leh: hay "eno chayyayv ad shettehe naara betula meorasa" – eno chayyayv ella al naara betula meorasa mibbee leh! vetu la middi.
Bea minneh rabbi yaakov bar adda merav: ba al hakketanna meorasa lerabbi meir, mahu? legamre memaet leh, o missekila memaet leh? amar leh: mistabbera missekila memaet leh.
Vehachtiv: "umetu gam shenehem", ad sheyyehu shenehen shavin? shetek rav.
Amar shemuel: may tama shetek rav? venema leh: "umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo"!
Ketannae: "umetu gam shenehem" – ad sheyyehu shenehen shavin, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: "umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo".
Veiddach, hahi "umetu gam shenehem" may daresh beh? amar rava: lemaote maase chiddudim. veiddach? maase chiddudim lav kelum hi.
Veiddach, hay "levaddo" may daresh beh?
Kidtanya: bau aleha asara bene adam, vaadayin hi betula – kullam biskila. rabbi omer: harishon biskila, vechullan bechenek.
Tanu rabbanan: "uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot", rabbi omer: techilla, vechen hu omer: "umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo".
May kaamar? amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: rabbi kerabbi yishmael sevira leh, deamar arusa yatza lisrefa velo nesua. vehachi kaamar: im techillat bia biznut – bisrefa, iddach – bechenek.
May "vechen"? ki hatam: ma hatam bitchillat bia kamishtae kera, hacha name bitchillat bia kamishtae kera.
Amar leh rav bivi bar abbaye: mar la hachi amar. umannu? rav yosef.
Rabbi, kerabbi meir sevira leh, deamar: nisset leechad min happesulin – mitatah bechenek.
Vehachi kaamar: im techillat achalatah biznut – bisrefa, veiddach – bechenek. umay "vechen"?

a: Simana bealma.
Mishna hammesit – ze hedyot, vehammesit et hahedyot. amar: yesh yira bemakom peloni, kach ochelet, kach shote, kach metiva, kach merea.
Kol chayyayve mitot shebbetora, en machminin alehem, chutz mizzo.
Amar lishnayim: hen edav, umeviin oto levet din vesoklin oto. amar leechad: hu omer "yesh li chaverim rotzim bechach".

Im haya arum veeno yachol ledabber bifnehem, machminin lo edim achore haggader. vehu omer lo: "emor ma sheamarta beyichud!" vehalla omer lo. vehu omer lo: "heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venelech venaavod etzim vaavanim?" im chozer bo – hare ze mutav, veim amar: "kach hi chovatenu, kach yafe lanu" – haomdin meachore haggader meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto.

Haomer: "eevod", "elech veeevod", "nelech venaavod"; "ezbach", "elech veezbach", "nelech venizbach"; "aktir", "elech veaktir", "nelech venaktir"; "anassech", "elech vaanassech", "nelech unenassech"; "eshtachave", "elech veeshtachave", "nelech venishtachave".
Gemara hammesit ze hedyot. tama dehedyot, ha navi bechenek. vehammesit et hahedyot, tama deyachid, ha rabbim bechenek.
Matnitin manni? rabbi shimon hi, detanya: navi shehediach – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bechenek. maddiche ir hanniddachat – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bechenek.
Ema sefa: hammaddiach ze haomer "nelech venaavod avoda zara". veamar rav yehuda amar rav: maddiche ir hanniddachat shanu. atan lerabbanan. resha rabbi shimon vesefa rabbanan?
Ravina amar: kullah rabbanan hi, vela zo af zo katane.
Rav pappa amar: ki katane "mesit ze hedyot", lehachemana.
Detanya: ushear kol chayyayve mitot shebbattora, en machminin alehen, chutz mizzo.

Ketzad osin lo? madlikin lo et hanner babbayit happenimi, umoshivin lo edim babbayit hachitzon, kede sheyyehu hen roin oto veshomin et kolo, vehu eno roe otan. vehalla omer lo: "emor ma sheamarta li beyichud", vehu omer lo. vehalla omer lo: "heach nanniach et elohenu shebbashshamayim venaavod avoda zara"? im chozer bo – mutav, veim amar: "kach hi chovatenu vechach yafe lanu" – haedim sheshshomin mibbachutz meviin oto levet din vesoklin oto.
Vechen asu leven satada belod, utelauhu beerev happesach.
Ben satada? ben pandira hu! amar rav chisda: baal satada, boel pandira. baal? pappus ben yehuda hu! ella, immo satada. immo? miryam megaddela neshayya havay! kidamri befumebdita: "setat da mibbala".
Mishna hammaddiach – ze haomer: "nelech venaavod avoda zara".

Hamechashshef – haose maase chayyayv, velo haochez et haenayim. rabbi akiva omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua: shenayim loktin kishshuin, echad loket patur veechad loket chayyayv. haose maase chayyayv, haochez et haenayim patur.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: maddiche ir hanniddachat shanu kan.
Hamechashshef – ze haose maase vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "mechashshefa" – echad haish veechad haishsha. im ken, ma talmud lomar "mechashshefa"? mippene sherov nashim metzuyot bichshafim.
Mitatan bamme? rabbi yose haggelili omer: neemar kan "mechashshefa lo techayye", veneemar lehallan "lo techayye kol neshama". ma lehallan besayif, af kan besayif.
Rabbi akiva omer: neemar kan "mechashshefa lo techayye", veneemar lehallan "im behema im ish lo yichye". ma lehallan biskila, af kan biskila.
Amar lo rabbi yose: ani danti "lo techayye" millo techayye", veatta danta "lo techayye" millo yichye"!
Amar lo rabbi akiva: ani danti yisrael miyyisrael, sheribba bahen hakkatuv mitot harebe, veatta danta yisrael miggoyim, shello ribba bahen hakkatuv ella
b: Mita achat.
Ben azzay omer: neemar "mechashshefa lo techayye", veneemar "kol shochev im behema mot yumat". semacho inyan lo, ma shochev im behema biskila – af mechashshef biskila.

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: vechi mippene shessemacho inyan lo, notzi laze biskila? ella, ov veyiddeoni bichlal mechashshefim hayu, velamma yatzu? lehakkish alehen velomar lach: ma ov veyiddeoni biskila – af mechashshef biskila.
Lerabbi yehuda name, lihvo ov veyiddeoni shene chetuvim habbaim keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin!
Amar rabbi zecharya: ada amra, kasavar rabbi yehuda: shene chetuvin habbain keechad melammedin.
Amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra sheman keshafim? shemmachchishin pamalya shel mala.
"En od milvaddo", amar rabbi chanina: afillu lidvar keshafim.
Hahi itteta dahavat ka mehaddera lemishkal afra mittute kareh derabbi chanina. amar la: i mistayyayt, zili avidi. "en od milvaddo" ketiv.
Ini? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra sheman mechashshefim? shemmachchishin pamalya shel mala. shane rabbi chanina, dinfish zechuteh.
Amar rabbi ayyvu bar naggare amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: "belatehem" – ellu maase shedim, "belahatehem" – ellu maase cheshafim. vechen hu omer: "veet lahat hacherev hammithappechet".
Amar abbaye: dekafed ammana – shed, dela kafed ammana – keshafim.
Amar abbaye: hilchot keshafim kehilchot shabbat, yesh mehen biskila, veyesh mehen patur aval asur, veyesh mehen muttar lechattechilla.

Haose maase – biskila, haochez et haenayim – patur aval asur. muttar lechattechilla – kidrav chanina verav oshaya: kol maale shabbeta havo aski behilchot yetzira, umibbere lehu igla tilta, veachli leh.
Amar rav ashe: chazena leh laavu dekarna, denafetz veshade keriche deshirae minnechireh.
"Vayyomru hachartummim el paro etzba elohim hi". amar rabbi eliezer: mikkan sheen hashshed yachol livroot beriyya pachot mikkisora.
Rav pappa amar: haelohim! afillu kegamla name la matze bare. hay mikkenif leh, vehay la mikkenif leh.

Amar leh rav lerabbi chiyyay: ledidi chaze li hahu tayyaya, deshakleh lesafsira vegayyeydeh legamle, uteraf leh betavla, vekam. amar leh: levatar hachi, dam ufarta mi havay? ella, hahi achizat enayim hava.

Zeeri ikkela laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. zevan chamra. ki meta leashkoyeh mayya, peshar vekam gamla deusekanita. amaru leh: i lav zeeri at, la hava mahderinan lach. mi ikka dezaven midde hacha vela badek leh ammayya?

Yannay ikkela lehahu ushepiza. amar lehu: ashkeyan mayya. karivu shetita. chaza deka merachashan sifvavta, sheda pureta minneh. havo akrabbe. amar lehu: ana shetay middidchu, attun name sheto middidi. ashkeyay, havay chamra. rachva, salek leshuka. ata chavertah, peshara la. chazyeh derachev vekae aitteta beshuka.
"Vattaal hatztzefardea vattechas et eretz mitzrayim". amar rabbi elazar: tzefardea achat hayta, hishritza umillea kol eretz mitzrayim.

Ketannae: rabbi akiva omer, tzefardea achat hayta umillea kol eretz mitzrayim. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya: akiva, ma lecha etzel haggada? kalle middabberotecha velech etzel negaim veohalot. tzefardea achat hayta, sharka lahem vehem bau.
Amar rabbi akiva kulei.

a: Veha rabbi akiva merabbi yehoshua gemir la? vehatanya: keshechala rabbi eliezer, nichnesu rabbi akiva vachaverav levakkero. hu yoshev bekinof shello, vehen yoshvin bitraklin shello.

Veoto hayyom erev shabbat haya, venichnas hurekanos beno lachlotz tefillav. gaar bo veyatza binzifa. amar lahen lachaverav: kimdumme ani sheddato shel abba nitrefa. amar lahen: dato vedaat immo nitrefa! heach mannichin issur sekila veoskin beissur shevut?
Kevan sherau chachamim sheddato meyushshevet alav, nichnesu veyashvu lefanav merachok arba ammot.

Amar lahem: lamma batem? amru lo: lilmod tora banu. amar lahem: vead achshav lamma lo batem? amru lo: lo haya lanu penay. amar lahen: tameah ani im yamutu mitat atzman. amar lo rabbi akiva: shelli mahu? amar lo: shellecha kasha mishshellahen.

Natal shete zerootav vehinnichan al libbo, amar: oy lachem shete zerootayy, shehen kishte sifre tora shenniglalin! harebe tora lamadti, veharebe tora limmadti. harebe tora lamadti, velo chissarti merabbotay afillu kakkelev hammelakkek min hayyam. harebe tora limmadti, velo chisseruni talmiday ella kemichchol bishfoferet.

Velo od, ella sheani shone shelosh meot halachot bevaheret azza, velo haya adam shoaleni bahen davar meolam. velo od, ella sheani shone shelosh meot halachot, veamri la: sheloshet alafim halachot, bintiat kishshuin, velo haya adam shoaleni bahen davar meolam, chutz meakiva ben yosef.

Paam achat ani vahu mehallechin hayinu badderech, amar li: rabbi, lammedeni bintiat kishshuin. amarti davar echad, nitmallea kol hassade kishshuin. amar li: rabbi, limmadtani netiatan, lammedeni akiratan. amarti davar echad, nitkabbetzu kullan lemakom echad.
Amru lo: hakkaddur vehaimmum vehakkamea utzeror hammargaliyyot umishkolet ketanna, mahu? amar lahen: hen temein, vetaharatan bema shehen.
Minal sheal gabbe haimmum, mahu? amar lahen: hu tahor, veyatza nishmato betohora. amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar: huttar hanneder, huttar hanneder!

Lemotzae shabbat paga bo rabbi akiva ben kesari lelod. haya makke bivsaro ad sheddamo shotet laaretz. patach alav beshura veamar: avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav. harebe maot yesh li veen li shulechani leharetzotan.
Alma, merabbi eliezer gamra? gamra merabbi eliezer vela savra. hadar gamra merabbi yehoshua, veasbera nihaleh.
Hechi aved hachi? vehaanan tenan: haose maase – chayyayv! lehitlammed shane, deamar mar: "lo tilmad laasot" – laasot i atta lamed, aval atta lamed lehavin ulehorot.
Hadaran alach arba mitot
b: Mishna ben sorer umore, meematay naase ben sorer umore?

Mishsheyyavi shete searot, vead sheyyakkif zakan hattachton velo haelyon, ella sheddibberu chachamim bilshon nekiyya. shenneemar: "ki yihye leish ben" – ben velo bat, ben velo ish. katan patur, shello ba lichlal mitzvot.
Gemara katan menalan defatur? menalan?! kidkatane tama: shello ba lichlal mitzvot! vetu, hecha ashkechan deanash hakkatuv, dehacha live kera lemiftereh?
Anan hachi kaamrinan: attu ben sorer umore al cheto neherag? al shem sofo neherag! vechevan deal shem sofo neherag, afillu katan name? veod, "ben" velo ish – katan mashma!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: deamar kera, "vechi yihye leish ben" – ben hassamuch ligvurato shel ish.
Vead sheyyakkif zakan hattachton kulei. tane rabbi chiyyay: ad sheyyakkif atara. ki ata rav dimi amar: hakkafat gid, velo hakkafat betzim.

Amar rav chisda: katan sheholid, en beno naase ben sorer umore, shenneemar: "ki yihye leish ben" – leish ben, velo leven ben. hay mibbee leh lechidrav yehuda amar rav! im ken, lema kera: "ki yihye ben leish". may "ki yihye leish ben"? shema minna lechidrav chisda.
Veema: kulleh lehachi hu daata? im ken, nema kera "ben ish". may "leish ben"? shema minna tarte.
Ufeliga derabba, deamar rabba: katan eno molid, shenneemar: "veim en laish goel". vechi yesh lecha adam beyisrael sheen lo goel?
Ella, begezel hagger hakkatuv medabber.

a: Veamar rachamana: "ish". ish – atta tzarich lachazor alav im yesh lo goalin veim lav. katan – i atta tzarich lachazor alav, beyadua sheen lo goalin.
Etiveh abbaye: "ish" – en li ella ish. ben tesha shanim veyom echad sherauy levia minnayin? talmud lomar: "veish".
Amar leh: yesh lo veeno molid, kitvua shello hevia shelish dame.

Deve chizkiyya tana: "vechi yazid ish" – ish mezid umazria, veen katan mezid umazria. amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: may mashma dehay "mezid" lishshana devashshole hu? dichtiv: "vayyazed yaakov nazid".
Veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "ben" – velo av?

Hechi dame? illema deiabbar batar deayyti shete searot, veoled mikkamme delakkef zakan – mi ikka shehut kulle hay? veha amar rabbi kerusepaday: kol yamav shel ben sorer umore eno ella shelosha chodashim bilvad! ella lav deiabbar mikkamme delayyte shete searot, veoled mikkammeh delakkef zakan, ushema minna: katan moled!
La, leolam deiabbar batar deayyti shete searot, veolid batar deakkef zakan. udeka kashya derabbi kerusepaday – ki ata rav dimi amar: amri bemareva "ben" – velo harauy likroto av.

Gufa, amar rabbi kerusepaday amar rabbi shabbetay: kol yamav shel ben sorer umore enan ella shelosha chodashim bilvad. vehaanan tenan: mishsheyyavi shete searot vead sheyyakkif zakan! hikkif zakan – af al gav dela melo shelosha chodashim. melo shelosha chodashim – af al gav delo hikkif.

Yatev rabbi yaakov minnehar pekod kammeh deravina, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua: shema minna midderabbi kerusepaday amar rabbi shabbetay, yoledet leshiva en ubbarah nikkar lishlish yameha.
Dei salka datach: ubbarah nikkar lishlish yameha, lema li shelosha? bitre vetilta saggi!
Amar leh: leolam ema lach, ubbarah nikkar lishlish yameha. zil batar rubba.
Amruha kammeh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua. amar leh: uvedine nefashot mi azlinan batar rubba? hattora amra: "veshaftu haeda vehitztzilu haeda", veat amrat zil batar rubba?!

Ahderuha kammeh deravina. amar leh: uvedine nefashot la azlinan batar rubba? vehatnan: echad omer "bishnayim bachodesh" veechad omer "bishlosha", edutan kayyemet, shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh veze eno yodea.

Vei salka datach la amrinan zil batar rubba, nema: hane davka ka mashadi, veachchoshe hu deka machchashi ahadade! ella lav mishshum deamrinan zil batar rubba, verubba deinashe avidi detau beibbura deyarcha!
Amar rabbi yirmeya middifti: af anan name tenena, bat shalosh shanim veyom echad mitkaddeshet bevia, veim ba aleha yavam – kenaah, vechayyayvin aleha mishshum eshet ish.

Umetammea et boalah, letamme mishkav hattachton keelyon. nisset lakkohen – ochelet bitruma. ba aleha echad min happesulin – pesalah min hakkehunna. veim ba aleha echad mikkol haarayot haamurot betora – mumatin aleha, vehi petura.
b: Ammay? ema: ayylonit hi, veaddata dehachi la kaddesh! ella, lav deamrinan: zil batar rubba, verov nashim lav ayylonit ninhu.
La, may "chayyayv aleha" dekatane? korban.
Veha "mumatin al yadah" katane? beva aleha aviha.
Veha "im ba aleha echad mikkol haarayot" katane? ella, hacha bemay askinan: dekabbela illaveh.
Tanu rabbanan: hamesolelet bivnah katan, veheera bah – bet shammay omrim: pesalah min hakkehunna, uvet hillel machshirin.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bereh derabba bar nachmani: amar rav chisda, veamri la amar rav chisda amar zeeri: hakkol modim beven tesha shanim veyom echad shebbiato bia, pachot mibben shemone sheen biato bia. lo nechleku ella beven shemone, devet shammay savri: gamrinan middorot harishonim, uvet hillel savri: la gamrinan middorot harishonim.

Vedorot harishonim menalan deolid? illema middichtiv: "halo zot bat sheva bat eliam eshet uriyya hachitti", uchetiv: "eliam ben achitofel haggiloni", uchetiv: "vayyishlach beyad natan hannavi vayyikra et shemo yedidyah baavur (ki) Adonai (ahevo)".
Uchetiv: "vayhi lishnatayim yamim vayyihyu gozzim leavshalom", uchetiv: "veavshalom barach vayyelech geshura vayhi sham shalosh shanim".

Uchetiv: "vayyeshev avshalom birushalaym shenatayim yamim ufene hammelech lo raa". uchetiv: "vayhi mikketz arbaim shana vayyomer avshalom el hammelech elcha na vaashallema et nidri asher nadarti laAdonai bechevron". uchetiv: "vaachitofel raa ki lo neesta atzato vayyachavosh et hachamor vayyakom vayyelech el beto veel iro vaytzav el beto vayyechanak".

Uchetiv: "anshe damim umirma lo yechetzu yemehem". vetanya: kol shenotav shel doeg enan ella sheloshim vearba, veshel achitofel enan ella sheloshim veshalosh. kamma havya lehu? telatin utelat. dal sheva dahava shelomo, pash lehu esrim veshet. dal tarte shene litlata ibbure, ishtechach dechol chad vechad betamne oled.
Mimmay? dilma tarvayyhu bitsha oled, uvat sheva olida beshet, mishshum deitteta barya. teda, deha havay la valad meikkara.

Ella mehacha: "elle toldot terach terach holid et avram et nachor veet haran". veavraham gadol minnachor shana, venachor gadol meharan shana. nimtza avraham gadol shete shanim meharan. uchetiv: "vayyikkach avram venachor lahem nashim vegomer".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: "yiska" zo sara, velamma nikra shemah "yiska"? shessocha beruach hakkodesh. vehayeynu dichtiv: "kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah". davar acher: "yiska" – shehakkol sachim beyofyah. uchetiv: "vayyippol [avraham] al panav vayyitzchak vayyomer belibbo vegomer". kamma kashshish avraham missara? asar shenin. vekashshish meavu tarten shenin. ishtechach ki olda haran lesara betamne olda.
Mimmay? dilma avraham zuta daachu hava, vederech chochmatan ka chashev lehu.

Teda deka chashev lehu kera derech chochmatan, uchetiv: "vayhi noach ben chamesh meot shana vayyoled noach et shem et cham veet yafet". shem gadol mecham shana, vecham gadol miyyefet shana. nimtza shem gadol miyyefet shete shanim. uchetiv: "venoach ben shesh meot shana vehammabbul haya mayim al haaretz". uchetiv: "(veelle) toldot shem shem ben meat shana vayyoled et arpachshad shenatayim achar hammabbul". ben mea shana? bar mea vetarten shenin hava!
Ella, derech chochmatan ka chashev lehu. hacha name, derech chochmatan ka chashev lehu.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea. amar li: attun mehacha matnitu, vaanan mehacha matnenan la: "uleshem yullad gam hu avi kol bene ever achi yefet haggadol". yefet haggadol shebbeechav hava.

Ella menalan? mehacha: "uvetzalel ben uri ven chur lematte yehuda", uchetiv: "vattamot azuva eshet kalev vayyikkach lo chalev et efrat vatteled lo et chur". vechi avad betzalel mishkan bar kamma have? bar telesar, dichtiv: "ish ish mimmelachto asher hemma osim". vetanya: shana rishona asa moshe mishkan, sheniyya hekim mishkan veshalach meraggelim.

Uchetiv: "ben arbaim shana anochi bishloach moshe eved Adonai vegomer", "veatta hinne anochi hayyom ben chamesh ushemonim shana". kamma havya lehu? arbein. dal arbesar dahava betzalel, pasha lehu esrim veshet. dal tarte shene ditlata ibbure, ishtechach dechol chad vechad betamne oled.
Ben, velo bat. tanya: amar rabbi shimon: bedin hu shettehe bat reuya lihyot keven sorer umore,

a: Shehakkol metzuyin etzlah baavera, ella gezerat hakkatuv hi: "ben", velo bat.
Mishna meematay chayyayv? mishsheyyochal tartemar basar, veyishte chatzi log yayin haitalki. rabbi yose omer: mane basar, velog yayin.

Achal bachavurat mitzva, achal beibbur hachodesh, achal maaser sheni birushalayim, achal nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim (achal tevel umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu).

Achal davar shehu mitzva, vedavar shehu avera, achal kol maachol velo achal basar, shata kol mashke velo shata yayin – eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin, shenneemar: "zolel vesove". veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar shenneemar: "al tehi vesove yayin bezolle vasar lamo".
Gemara amar rabbi zera: tartemar ze eni yodea mahu, ella mittoch shekkafal rabbi yose beyayin, nimtza kofel af babbasar, venimtza tartemar chatzi mane.
Amar rav chanan bar molada amar rav huna: eno chayyayv ad sheyyikkach basar bezol veyochal, yayin bezol veyishte, dichtiv: "zolel vesove".

Veamar rav chanan bar molada amar rav huna: eno chayyayv ad sheyyochal basar chay veyishte yayin chay. ini? veha rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: achal basar chay veshata yayin chay eno naase ben sorer umore! amar ravina: yayin chay – mezig vela mezig, basar chay – beshil vela beshil, kivsar kiva deachli gannave.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvavyyhu: achal basar maliach veshata yayin miggitto, en naase ben sorer umore. tenan hatam: erev tisha beav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, velo yochal basar, velo yishte yayin. vetana: aval ochel hu basar maliach veshote yayin miggitto.
Bevasar maliach, ad kamma? amar rabbi chanina bar kahana: kol zeman shehu kishlamim.
Veyayin miggitto, ad kamma? kol zeman shehu toses. vehatanya: yayin toses en bo mishshum gilluy. vechamma tesisato? shelosha yamim.
Hacha may? hatam mishshum simcha hu, kol zeman shehu kishlamim name it beh simcha. hacha mishshum immeshoche hu, uvechol shehu la mimmeshich. veyayin – ad arbaim yom.
Amar rav chanan: lo nivra yayin baolam ella lenachem avelim, uleshallem sachar larshaim, shenneemar: "tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "al tere yayin ki yitaddam"? al tere yayin shemmaadim penehem shel reshaim baolam hazze, umalbin penehem laolam habba. rava amar: "al tere yayin ki yitaddam" – al tere yayin sheacharito dam.
Rav kahana rame: ketiv "tirash" vekarenan "tirosh". zacha – naase rosh, lo zacha – naase rash.
Rava rame: ketiv "yeshammach" vekarenan "yesammach". zacha – mesammecho, lo zacha – meshammemehu. vehayeynu deamar rava: chamra verechane pakkachin.

Amar rav amram bereh derabbi shimon bar abba, amar rabbi chanina: may dichtiv "lemi oy lemi avoy lemi medanim lemi siach lemi petzaim chinnam lemi chachlilut enayim (vegomer) lamacharim al hayyayin labbaim lachkor mimsach"? ki ata rav dimi amar: amri bemareva, hay kera man dedaresh leh meresheh lesefeh – midderish, umissefeh leresheh – midderish.

Daresh over galilaa: shelosh esre vavin neemar bayyayin: "vayyachel noach ish haadama, vayyitta karem, vayyesht min hayyayin, vayyishkar, vayyitgal betoch oholo, vayyar cham avi chenaan et ervat aviv, vayyagged lishne echav bachutz, vayyikkach shem vayefet et hassimla, vayyasimu al shechem shenehem, vayyelchu achorannit, vaychassu et ervat avihem ufenehem vegomer", "vayyiketz noach miyyeno, vayyeda et asher asa lo beno hakkatan".
Rav ushemuel: chad amar serso, vechad amar revao.

Man deamar serso: mittoch shekkilkelo barvii, killelo barvii. uman deamar revao: gamar "vayyar" "vayyar". ketiv hacha: "vayyar cham avi chenaan et ervat aviv", uchetiv hatam: "vayyar otah shechem ben chamor vegomer".
Bishlama leman deamar serso, mishshum hachi killelo barvii. ella leman deamar revao, may shena revii? nilteyeh behedya! ha veha havay.

"Vayyachel noach ish haadama vayyitta karem". amar rav chisda amar rav ukeva, veamri la mar ukeva amar rabbi zakkay: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lenoach: noach, lo haya lecha lilmod meadam harishon shello garam lo ella yayin? keman deamar oto ilan sheachal mimmennu adam harishon – gefen haya.
Detanya: rabbi meir omer, oto ilan sheachal adam harishon mimmennu – gefen haya,
b: Sheen lecha davar shemmevi yelala leadam ella yayin. rabbi yehuda omer: chitta haya, sheen hattinok yodea likro abba veimma ad sheyyitom taam dagan. rabbi nechemya omer: teena haya, shebbaddavar shekkilkelu bo nitkenu, shenneemar: "vayyitperu ale teena".

"Divre lemuel melech massa asher yisserattu immo". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: melammed shekkefaattu immo al haammud veamra lo, "ma beri uma bar bitni ume bar nedaray". "ma beri" – hakkol yodim sheavich yere shamayim hava, achshav yomru immo garma lo.
"Uma bar bitni" – kol hannashim shel bet avicha, kevan shemmitabberot, shuv enan root pene hammelech. vaani dachakti venichnasti, kede sheyyehe li ben mezoraz umelubban.
"Uma bar nedaray" – kol nashim shel bet avicha hayu nodrot: "yehe li ben hagun lammalchut", vaani nadarti veamarti: "yehe li ben zariz umemulla battora vehagun linviut".

"Al lamlachim lemoel, al lamlachim sheto yayin". "al lamlachim" – amra lo: ma lecha etzel melachim sheshshotim yayin umishtakkerim veomrim lamma lanu el? "uleroznim e shechar" – mi shekkol raze olam geluyim lo yishte yayin veyishtakker? ikka deamri: mi shekkol rozne olam mashkimin lefitcho yishte yayin veyishtakker?

Amar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shechazar shelomo vehoda leimmo? dichtiv: "ki vaar anochi meish velo vinat adam li". "ki vaar anochi meish" – minnoach, dichtiv: "vayyachel noach ish haadama". "velo vinat adam li" – ze adam harishon.
Achal bachavurat mitzva. amar rabbi avahu: eno chayyayv ad sheyyochal bachavura shekkullah serikin.

Vehaanan tenan: achal bachavurat mitzva – eno naase ben sorer umore. tama demitzva, ha lav mitzva – af al gav delav kullah serikin? ha ka mashma lan: deaf al gav dechullah serikin, kevan divmitzva ka asek – la mimmeshich.

Achal beibbur hachodesh. lememra devasar veyayin masseku? vehatanya: en olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit bilvad! ha ka mashma lan: af al gav deen olin lah ella befat vekitnit, veihu assek basar veyayin vaachal, kevan divmitzva ka asek – la mimmeshich.

Tanu rabbanan: en olin beibbur hachodesh pachot measara bene adam, veen olin lah ella befat dagan vekitnit, veen olin lah ella leor ibburo, veen olin lah bayyom ella ballayla. vehatanya: en olin lah ballayla ella bayyom! kedaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba livneh: achrifu veulu, achrifu ufuku, ki hechi delishmeu bechu inashe.
Achal maaser sheni birushalayim. kevan dechi orcheh hu ka achel leh, la mimmeshich.
Achal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim. amar rava: achal besar of – eno naase ben sorer umore.
Veha anan tenan: achal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim – eno naase ben sorer umore. ha tehorin – naase ben sorer umore? ki tenan name matnitin – lehashelim.
Achal davar shehu mitzva, udevar avera. devar mitzva – tanchume avelim, devar avera – taanit tzibbur.
Vetama may? amar kera: "enennu shomea bekolenu" – bekolenu, velo bekolo shel makom.

Achal kol maachol velo achal basar, shata kol mashke velo shata yayin vechulei. achal kol maachol velo achal basar – leetoye devela keilit. shata kol mashke velo shata yayin – leetoye devash vechalav.
Detanya: achal devela keilit, veshata devash vechalav, venichnas lammikdash –

a: Chayyayv.

Eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin. tanu rabbanan: achal kol maachol velo achal basar, shata kol mashke velo shata yayin – eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyochal basar veyishte yayin, shenneemar: "zolel vesove".

Veaf al pi sheen reayay laddavar, zecher laddavar shenneemar: "al tehi vesove yayin bezolle vasar lamo", veomer: "ki sove vezolel yivvaresh ukeraim talbish numa". amar rabbi zera: kol hayyashen bevet hammidrash torato naaset lo keraim keraim, shenneemar: "ukeraim talbish numa".

Mishna ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv, mishshel acherim veachal birshut acherim, mishshel acherim veachal birshut aviv – eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv veyochal birshut acherim. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv umishshel immo.
Gemara ganav mishshel aviv veachal birshut aviv. af al gav dishchiach leh, beit.
Mishshel acherim veachal birshut acherim. af al gav dela beit – la shechiach leh. vechol shekken mishshel acherim veachal birshut aviv, dela shechiach leh uveit.
Ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv, veyochal birshut acherim. dishchiach leh, vela beit.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyignov mishshel aviv umishshel immo. immo mena la? ma shekkanta ishsha kana balah! amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: misseuda hammuchenet leaviv uleimmo.
Vehaamar rabbi chanan bar molada amar rav huna: eno chayyayv ad sheyyikne basar bezol veyochal, yayin bezol veyishte? ella, ema: middeme seuda hammuchenet leaviv uleimmo.
Ibbaet ema: deakni la acher, vaamar la: "al menat sheen levalich reshut bahen".

Mishna haya aviv rotze veimmo enah rotze, aviv eno rotze veimmo rotza – eno naase ben sorer umore ad sheyyehu shenehem rotzin. rabbi yehuda omer: im lo hayta immo reuya leaviv, eno naase ben sorer umore.
Gemara may "enah reuya"? illema chayyayve charetot vechayyayve mitot bet din, sof sof avu avu nihu, veimmeh immeh nihi!

Ella beshava leaviv kaamar. tanya name hachi: rabbi yehuda omer, im lo hayta immo shava leaviv bekol uvemare uvakkoma, eno naase ben sorer umore. may tama? deamar kera "enennu shomea bekolenu". middekol baenan shavin, mare vekoma name baenan shavin.
Keman azla ha detanya: ben sorer umore lo haya velo atid lihyot, velamma nichtav? derosh vekabbel sachar. keman? kerabbi yehuda.

Ibbaet ema: rabbi shimon hi, detanya, amar rabbi shimon: vechi mippene sheachal ze tartemar basar veshata chatzi log yayin haitalki, aviv veimmo motziin oto lesoklo? ella lo haya velo atid lihyot, velamma nichtav? derosh vekabbel sachar. amar rabbi yonatan: ani reitiv veyashavti al kivro.

Keman azla ha detanya: ir hanniddachat lo hayta velo atida lihyot, velamma nichteva – derosh vekabbel sachar. keman? kerabbi eliezer, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer, kol ir sheyyesh bah afillu mezuza achat enah naaset ir hanniddachat.

May tama? amar kera: "veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vesarafta vaesh". vechevan dei ikka mezuza, la efshar, dichtiv: "lo taasun ken laAdonai elohechem". amar rabbi yonatan: ani reitiha veyashavti al tillah.

Keman azla ha detanya: bayit hamenugga lo haya velo atid lihyot, velamma nichtav – derosh vekabbel sachar. keman? kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, ditnan: rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer, leolam en habbayit tame ad sheyyerae kishte gerisin al shete avanim bishte chetalim bekeren zavit, orko kishne gerisin verochbo kigris.
May tama derabbi elazar berabbi shimon? ketiv "kir" uchetiv "kirot". ezehu kir shehu kekirot? heve omer: ze keren zavit.

Tanya: amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, makom haya bitchum azza, vehayu korin oto churebata segirta. amar rabbi shimon ish kefar akko: paam achat halachti legalil veraiti makom shemmetzayyeynin oto, veamru: avanim menuggaot pinu lesham.

Mishna haya echad mehem giddem, o chigger, o illem, o some, o cheresh – eno naase ben sorer umore, shenneemar: "vetafsu vo aviv veimmo" – velo gidmin, "vehotziu oto" – velo chiggerin, "veamru" – velo illemin, "benenu ze" – velo somin, "enennu shomea bekolenu" – velo chershin.
Matrin bo bifne shelosha, umalkin oto. chazar vekilkel – niddon beesrim ushelosha, veeno niskal ad sheyyehu sham shelosha harishonim, shenneemar: "benenu ze" – zehu shellaka bifnechem.
Gemara shamat minna: baenan kera kedichtiv? shane hacha,
b: Dechulleh kera yattira hu.
Umatrin bifne shelosha? lema li? bitre sagya! amar abbaye: hachi kaamar – matrin bo bifne shenayim, umalkin oto bifne shelosha.
Malkut beven sorer umore hecha ketiva? kidrabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu: lamadnu "veyisseru" mivveyisseru", "veyisseru" mibben", uven" mibbin" – "vehaya im bin hakkot harasha".
Chazar vekilkel, niddon beesrim ushelosha [vechulei]. hay mibbee leh: "ze" – velo somin? im ken, lichtov "benenu hu". may "benenu ze"? shema minna tarte.
Mishna barach ad shello nigmar dino, veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton – patur. veim mishshennigmar dino barach, veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton – chayyayv.
Gemara amar rabbi chanina: ben noach shebberach et hashshem veachar kach nitgayyer – patur, hoil venishtanna dino, nishtannet mitato.
Nema mesayyeya leh: barach ad shello nigmar dino, veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton – patur. may tama? lav mishshum deamrinan: hoil veishtanni – ishtanni?
La, shane hacha, dei avad hasheta – lav bar ketala hu.
Ta shema: im mishshennigmar dino barach, veachar kach hikkif zakan hattachton – chayyayv. nigmar dino kaamrat? nigmar dino gavra ketila hu!
Ta shema: ben noach shehikka et chavero, uva al eshet chavero, venitgayyer – patur. asa ken beyisrael venitgayyer – chayyayv. veammay? nema: hoil veishtanni – ishtanni!
Dino umitato baenan, vehay – dino ishtanni, mitato la ishtannay.
Bishlama rotzeach, meikkara sayif vehasheta sayif. ella eshet ish, meikkara sayif vehasheta chenek?
Benaara hameorasa, deidde veidde biskila.
Veha "asa ken beyisrael", dumeya deeshet chavero katane.
Ella, kalla bachamura meshach shayycha.
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri: "sayif chamur", ella lerabbi shimon deamar: "chenek chamur", may ikka lememar?
Rabbi shimon savar la ketanna deve menashshe, deamar: kol mita haamura livne noach enah ella chenek.
Bishlama eshet ish, meikkara chenek vehasheta chenek. ella rotzeach, meikkara chenek vehasheta sayif? kalla bachamura meshach shayycha.

Lema mesayyeya leh: sarcha, veachar kach bagra – tiddon bechenek. biskila may tama la? lav mishshum dehoil veishtannay ishtanni? vechol shekken hacha deishtanni ligmare! haamar leh rabbi yochanan letanna: teni "tiddon biskila".
Mishna ben sorer umore niddon al shem sofo. yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyayv, shemmitatan shel reshaim – hanaa lahen vahanaa laolam. latztzaddikim – ra lahen vera laolam.
